name: The Young and the Restless
description: The rivalries, romances, hopes and fears of the residents of the fictional Midwestern metropolis, Genoa City. The lives and loves of a wide variety of characters mingle through the generations, dominated by the Newman, Abbott, Baldwin and Winters families.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Sharon and Nick win custody of Cassie.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Victor and Nikki host a party at the Newman Ranch to celebrate Cassie's adoption.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Nikki and Victor remarry.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Friends and family attend Nikki and Victor's wedding.

videos.title: Episode 10121 - Monday, March 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Kyle reassures Phyllis that he sees Summer as nothing more than a friend. Phyllis explains to Summer that Kyle isn’t interested in her and she should let her crush go. 

Sharon confronts Noah about hooking up with Adriana after the weeding. Noah fires back by saying people can change and brings up her relationship with Adam.

The Newman’s scramble to disarm the gunman while a family member is rushed to the hospital. Later, Congressman Wheeler overhears Abby tell Kyle about the horrible incident at the ranch.

Nick and Avery talk about the bouquet that she caught at the wedding and what it means for their future.

videos.title: Episode 10122 - Tuesday, March 26, 2013
videos.overview:
After surviving the ordeal at the ranch, Victoria decides that she wants to expand her and Billy's legacy by having a baby.  The Newman family gather at the hospital and discuss the fallout of the shooting.

Avery and Nick are startled by Dylan when he arrives at the tack house with a gift for Faith. Dylan reveals that he is leaving for Chicago, for good. Nick excuses himself so Avery and Dylan can say their goodbyes.  Michael presses Lauren to be completely honest with him. Lauren shoots down the idea of marriage counseling.

videos.title: Episode 10123 - Wednesday, March 27, 2013
videos.overview:
Phyllis tells Jack she backed out of their trip because she found Summer half naked in front of Kyle in his office. Jack offers to talk to Kyle but Phyllis thinks it's best if Summer interns for the Jabot fashion line with Neil. 

Neil has a heated conversation with Congressman Wheeler. Later, Wheeler is at the police station when he sees Bob brought it by Alex. Wheeler asks Paul to keep him updated on the progress of the case. 

Nikki and Victor return to the ranch for the first time since the shooting occurred. 

Tyler surprises Leslie when he says he is testifying for the prosecution in their father's case.

videos.title: Episode 10124 - Thursday, March 28, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack and Victor decide to work together to bring down Wheeler. Once Wheeler shows up at the ranch house, they accuse him of sending the shooter to Victor and Nikki's wedding. 

Kevin pleas with Michael to rethink the separation with Lauren. Lauren shows up at the GCAC while Carmine is working behind the bar. 

Cane becomes worried with Katherine after she continuously shows severe forgetfulness at their lunch. Meanwhile, Chloe spots a box of expensive items marked as a donation to charity at Kay's mansion. 

Alex and Paul question Wheeler about his relationship with Victor.

videos.title: Episode 10125 - Friday, March 29, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe urges Chelsea to tell Adam about their baby. 

Billy and Victoria continue to plan for their future baby. They run into Chloe at the hospital after their appointment with their fertility doctor. Billy asks Chloe if he can spend more time with Delia. 

Lily forces Tyler to face his true emotions about his father and his murder trial. Tyler opens up and reveals his real name to her. 

Cane learns that Katherine has diagnosed herself with Alzheimer's and urges her to go see a doctor and she agrees. 

Dylan is at a roadside bar when an unruly patron starts to harass the bartender. Nick surprises Avery with a romantic evening set up in her apartment.

videos.title: Episode 10126 - Monday, April 1, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria asks Chelsea if things are really over for Adam and Chelsea since he was a different, happier person when they were together.

Victor tells Nikki he has guards at the ranch and his own investigators working on figuring out who was behind the ambush on their wedding.

Paul and Alex question Jack's relationship with Congressman Wheeler and his daughter Stephanie. Later, Jack and Victor decide they need to rethink their plan.

Lily stops a fight between Cane and Tyler. Cane leaves to meet with Katherine.

Katherine's doctor gives her a series of memory tests.

videos.title: Episode 10127 - Tuesday, April 2, 2013
videos.overview:
Tyler tells Leslie he isn’t going to let their disagreement get in between them anymore. Avery shows up and lets them know that they will have a ruling on Gus’ case today.

Paul and Alex question Wheeler about his daughter. Later, Victor, Jack and Wheeler make a deal to fund his next campaign in exchange for his silence on their involvement in Stephanie’s death.

Nick learns that there were complications with Dylan’s bail and that he spend the night on Avery’s couch. Nick offers Dylan his old bartending job back at The Underground.

Summer is excited to spend the day interning with KylTyler tells Leslie he isn’t going to let their disagreement get in between them anymore. Avery shows up and lets them know that they will have a ruling on Gus’ case today.

Paul and Alex question Wheeler about his daughter. Later, Victor, Jack and Wheeler make a deal to fund his next campaign in exchange for his silence on their involvement in Stephanie’s death.

Nick learns that there were complications with Dylan’s bail and that he spend the night on Avery’s couch. Nick offers Dylan his old bartending job back at The Underground.

Summer is excited to spend the day interning with Kyle. Summer lets Phyllis know that she can’t keep her and Kyle away from each other. Later, Phyllis asks Nick to keep an eye on her while she’s in Istanbul.

videos.title: Episode 10128 - Wednesday, April 3, 2013
videos.overview:
Chelsea tells Adam's doctor to notify Sharon of his progress instead of her. Chelsea tells Chloe she isn't planning on telling Adam about the baby.

Michael returns to his apartment to pick up some clothes when Lauren tells him she is ready to do whatever it takes to save their marriage. Meanwhile, Carmine calls Lauren and asks to see her. Later, Michael tells Kevin that Lauren is ready to give their marriage another shot.

Jill accuses Adriana of stealing Katherine's box of items for charity.

videos.title: Episode 10129 - Thursday, April 4, 2013
videos.overview:
Lauren tells Michael that she realized she wants to be at home with her family. 

Paul and Alex tell Leslie they have new evidence in her mother's murder. 

Chelsea checks in on Adam who says he's been think about the second chance he's been given. Later, Victor stops by to visit Adam.

videos.title: Episode 10130 - Friday, April 5, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery learns that Nick has given Dylan his bartending job back at The Underground. Later, Avery comes back to The Underground and finds a romantic evening set up. Meanwhile, Dylan runs into Sharon at the coffeehouse and lets her know he's going to be staying in Genoa City longer than he planned.

Kyle tells Abby that Summer's crush on him will fade since she is now interning in the fashion division. Later, Summer sneaks into the Abbott mansion.

Adam questions Victor's sincerity and wants to know what it will take to stop the war between them.

Congressman Wheeler receives bad news from his lawyer. Later, he vows to take down Jack and Victor with him. Meanwhile, Leslie tells Tyler that their father will be released.

videos.title: Episode 10131 - Monday, April 8, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery considers Nick's proposal. 

Nikki learns that Victoria and Billy are trying to have another baby. 

When Kyle tells Summer he is interested in someone else, Summer researches how to get the attention of an older man.

Chelsea and Dylan bond over coffee at Crimson Lights. 

Victor tells Adam that Newman Enterprises is about family as they form a partnership. Later, Nikki warns Adam against tricking Victor. 

Congressman Wheeler is stunned to learn he is being charged with the murder of Belinda Rogan.

videos.title: Episode 10132 - Tuesday, April 9, 2013
videos.overview: Kevin and Chloe overhear Jill and Katherine arguing about Adriana and the missing box of charitable items. Kevin tries to cover his tracks and agrees with Jill when she says that Adriana is trouble. Billy and Victoria celebrate Johnny's first birthday. Kevin and Chloe drop off Delia for a visit. Cane and Lily agree to stop fighting over Tyler. Leslie, Tyler and Gus confront Congressman Wheeler at the police station about Belinda's murder.

videos.title: Episode 10133 - Wednesday, April 10, 2013
videos.overview: Summer succeeds at getting Kyle’s attention after she makes herself look older. Abby tells Summer she needs to let Kyle go since he is interested in someone else.  Sharon finds Avery’s engagement ring and questions Nick about his intentions. Later, Sharon tells Dylan about the proposal and he states that there may be hope for him and Avery. Chloe continues to try to convince Chelsea to pass her baby off as Dylan’s. Michael and Lauren try to spend an evening together for the first time in a while.

videos.title: Episode 10134 - Thursday, April 11, 2013
videos.overview: Michael suggests he and Lauren start marriage counseling. Lauren wants to get away from their problems and go on a vacation together. Later, Carmine shows up at Lauren and Michael's apartment unannounced. Paul becomes suspicious of Lauren and Carmine. Tyler has a hard time adjusting to Gus being out of prison. Victor and Adam agree to work together at Newman Enterprises. Victoria becomes jealous of their new-found relationship. Alex and Noah have a heated discussion about Adriana. Later, Noah and Tyler commiserate together over not being able to trust people.

videos.title: Episode 10135 - Friday, April 12, 2013
videos.overview: Jack and Phyllis enjoy their vacation in Istanbul when Jack gets a surprise call from Congressman Wheeler. The case against Wheeler reaches a shocking climax. Nick speaks to Summer and Kyle on separate occasions and warns both of them to stay away from each other. Kyle tells Nick he will stay away from Summer but he should be aware that her new mature look with attract attention from other guys. Nick tells Avery he wants to have more kids with her. Later, Dylan tells Avery that she'll be an excellent mother. Katherine is shocked when she receives her test results. Tyler confides in Lily about all of his issues with Gus.

videos.title: Episode 10136 - Monday, April 15, 2013
videos.overview:
When Nick tells Noah that he and Avery are engaged, Noah questions the timing of the proposal. Meanwhile, Dylan questions why Avery hasn't told Nick about a secret from their past. 

Neil and Leslie's romantic evening is interrupted by Gus. Later, Leslie finds a box of Gus' personal items. 

Lily makes Tyler promise her that he'll never kiss her again, and that they are just friends. Meanwhile, Katherine tells Cane that aside from Lily, no one else can know about her tumor. Cane tries to convince Katherine to tell Murphy and Jill about her diagnosis. 

Chloe tries to convince Chelsea to convince her to find a guy she can pass off as her baby's father.

videos.title: Episode 10137 - Tuesday, April 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Sharon brings Adam home from the hospital and offers to move back in to help him through his recovery. Later, Sharon runs into Chelsea at the coffeehouse. 

Victor meets with Abby, Nick, Billy, and Victoria for dinner to discuss a birthday celebration for Nikki. Victor also announces that he plans on running Newman Enterprises with Adam and asks if his other children will return to the company. 

Chloe and Chelsea walk in on Alex questioning Kevin about the missing charity items from the Chancellor mansion. Kevin and Chloe accuse Adriana of stealing the missing items. 

Avery receives a shocking offer from Dylan.

videos.title: Episode 10138 - Wednesday, April 17, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack tells Phyllis that he won't let rain ruin their last day during their vacation in Istanbul. As they enjoy a romantic day together, Jack asks Phyllis to move in with him. 

Avery agrees to watch Faith while Nick goes to Nikki's birthday dinner. Avery struggles to entertain a cranky Faith while Nick is away.

Adam questions Victoria's motives after she makes a shocking announcement at Nikki's birthday dinner. 

Michael comes home to a romantic setting that Lauren prepared. Later, Lauren receives a text from Carmine asking if they can still be friends. 

An acquaintance from Billy's past entices him with a deck of cards he's shuffling.

videos.title: Episode 10139 - Thursday, April 18, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery gets a call from Dylan asking her to meet him at the coffeehouse. Later, Nick confronts Avery about lying to him.

Adam, Billy, Carmine, Mason, and Michael play a high stakes poker game at On the Blvd.

Victor questions Victoria’s intentions at Newman Enterprises.

Carmine shows up at Lauren and Michael’s apartment. Lauren tells Carmine she doesn’t want to lose her marriage and he should go.

videos.title: Episode 10140 - Friday, April 19, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy shocks Victoria with the news that he bought On the Blvd. Victoria picks up on the awkwardness between Barry and Billy when they stop by the restaurant.

Leslie rants to Tyler and Neil about Gus making her crazy at home. Leslie becomes fed up with Gus' efforts to make up for years of abandonment. Later, Gus grasps at his chest.

Lily surprises herself when she finds herself becoming jealous of Tyler.

Sharon drops by Newman Enterprises to clean out her desk. Adam tells her he went to see Chelsea and asks if she thinks he can fix things between them. After some prodding from Adam, Sharon reveals to him that Chelsea is pregnant. 

Nick and Avery make up after their argument about Dylan. They discuss their wedding plans as Avery realizes that she needs to tell Phyllis about their engagement.

videos.title: Episode 10141 - Monday, April 22, 2013
videos.overview:
Noah tells Sharon about Avery and Nick's engagement. When Noah questions her feelings about the engagement, Sharon assures him that she has moved on. Meanwhile, Chelsea, Dylan, and Adam have a heated discussion at Crimson Lights. Later, Dylan shows up at Sharon's and tells her about Chelsea's pregnancy. 

Victor questions Victoria's motives about working at Newman Enterprises. Adam shows up, and tells Victor about Chelsea's pregnancy. 

Chloe and Kevin realize that their marriage is stuck in a rut and attempt to find a way to spice things up.

Leslie tells Tyler about Gus's heart attack. Leslie tells Tyler that she wants to focus more on building their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 10142 - Tuesday, April 23, 2013
videos.overview:
When Avery tells Phyllis about her engagement to Nick, Phyllis tells her that they're rushing into it for the wrong reasons. Later, Avery tries to reassure Nick by saying that Dylan isn't staying in town because of her. 

Sharon and Adam have a heated discussion as they navigate what they mean to each other. Meanwhile, Chelsea and Dylan determine their next moves. Later, Adam goes to visit Chelsea and they discuss the baby they lost. 

Jack asks if Phyllis is ready to move in with him. Jack receives a visit from John and ponders his complicated history with Phyllis.

videos.title: Episode 10143 - Wednesday, April 24, 2013
videos.overview:
When Neil asks Lily and Tyler to run an ad campaign, Lily is hesitant. Later, Lily recalls her kiss with Tyler. 

Meanwhile, Leslie urges Tyler to make peace with Gus. Later, Leslie decides to look through a box of Gus's personal items and she finds a stack of letters. 

Summer tells Phyllis that she wants to move in with her and Jack. 

Carmine promises not to tell Victoria about Billy's gambling. Later, Jack congratulates Billy on his new venture at the restaurant.

Fen tries to reach out to Summer and is angered when she rejects his advances. 

Michael and Lauren discuss their failed marriage and he tells her he needs to be somewhere else for a while. Fen worries that Michael is giving up on the family.

videos.title: Episode 10144 - Thursday, April 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam is adamant in telling Sharon that there can be no strings between them. 

Victoria tells Nick that he may have rushed his proposal to Avery. Later, Sharon tells Avery that if she isn't completely committed to Nick that she should end it immediately.

Anita overhears Chelsea and Dylan talking about the baby. When Anita grills Dylan about his future plans, Chelsea quickly shoots her down. 

Leslie and Tyler question him about a woman named Rose that he mentioned in the hospital Gus tells them she is someone from his past, but his monitor alarm goes off before he can elaborate.

Billy hires Dylan at his restaurant. Billy preemptively breaks up a heated confrontation between Adam and Dylan. Victoria overhears Adam tell Billy he's there to play cards with him.

videos.title: Episode 10145 - Friday, April 26, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam is adamant in telling Sharon that there can be no strings between them. 

Victoria tells Nick that he may have rushed his proposal to Avery. Later, Sharon tells Avery that if she isn't completely committed to Nick that she should end it immediately. 

Anita overhears Chelsea and Dylan talking about the baby. When Anita grills Dylan about his future plans, Chelsea quickly shoots her down. 

Leslie and Tyler question him about a woman named Rose that he mentioned in the hospital Gus tells them she is someone from his past, but his monitor alarm goes off before he can elaborate.

Billy hires Dylan at his restaurant. Billy preemptively breaks up a heated confrontation between Adam and Dylan. Victoria overhears Adam tell Billy he's there to play cards with him.

videos.title: Episode 10146 - Monday, April 29, 2013
videos.overview:
The complicated relationship between Adam and Sharon continues as they sleep together but Sharon realizes that he only is looking for a physical relationship.

Courtney gives Summer a fake ID, and they successfully sneak into The Underground. Tyler sees them and informs Mason that Summer is the new face of Jabot, and she needs to maintain a clean image. Later, Nick eventually catches Summer at the club. 

Avery confronts Dylan, and suggests he leaves town because he's affecting her relationship with Nick.

videos.title: Episode 10147 - Tuesday, April 30, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack and Phyllis welcome Summer to move into the Abbott mansion. Kyle assures them that there are no awkward feelings. Nick gets upset with Phyllis for not discussing the move with him. Later, Nick worries that Avery has feelings for Dylan and the question where they're headed. 

Dylan invites Avery to move to Chicago with him. Meanwhile, Chelsea admits to Chloe that she can't keep lying to Dylan.

Lily tells Devon that Katherine's tumor was benign. Jill finds out that Katherine has asked Cane to take over Chancellor Industries. 

Kyle walks in during Summer's photo shoot with Mason. Summer turns up the sex appeal during the shoot in order to get Kyle to notice her.

videos.title: Episode 10148 - Wednesday, May 1, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe and Kevin try to enjoy a spontaneous lunch date. Later, they agree that their marriage is in a rut. 

While telling Paul that he moved out to save his marriage, Michael is informed that Fen hasn't been to school in two days. Michael goes home and finds the deck of cards and the note that Carmine gave to Lauren. Lauren and Carmine enjoy some time away in Lake Geneva. Lauren eventually takes off, leaving an apology not for Carmine.

Gus is well enough to leave the hospital, but he still won't discuss Rose with Leslie. Later, Leslie opens one of his letters and suspects that Gus had an affair with Rose. 

Jill continues to protest Katherine's decision of putting Cane in charge of Chancellor Industries.

videos.title: Episode 10149 - Thursday, May 2, 2013
videos.overview:
Detective Sheryl Gordon helps Neil as he looks around his apartment after the robbery. Neil is shocked when he discovers his flashdrive was stolen. 

Michael questions Lauren about the deck of cards he found, but they're discussion is cut off by Paul calling to tell him about Fen being arrested. Paul asks Carmine what exactly is going on between him and Lauren. Paul warns Carmine to not cross any lines.

When Victor addresses the issue of Adam possibly being the father of Chelsea's baby, Adam quickly shoots the idea down.

Billy confronts Carmine about lying and calling into work sick.

videos.title: Episode 10150 - Friday, May 3, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery turns down Dylan's request to come meet up with him. Feeling conflicted; she begins to write an important letter to Nick.

Summer tells Nick that he needs to let her grow up and make her own choices. Nick informs Jack and Phyllis that Kyle is not someone he wants Summer hanging around with. 

In order to keep his job, Carmine offers to play a game of cards with Billy. 

Cane brings Katherine home from the hospital.

videos.title: Episode 10151 - Monday, May 6, 2013
videos.overview:
While Victoria is upstairs, Billy accidentally leaves a poker chip on the floor. Victor stops by to inform Victoria that Jabot is back in Jack's hands. Victoria tells Victor that she wants Adam out of Newman Enterprises. Later, Adam tells Victor that they should make Newman a private family company again. 

Paul questions Lauren about Carmine and tells her to fight for her marriage. Michael tells Kevin that he thinks Lauren has crossed a line she can't come back from. Meanwhile, Carmine gets upset when Lauren won't call him back. 

Chelsea is furious that Adam keeps bringing up the baby the lost. 

After he stops by for a house call, Nikki invites Dr. Costner to stay for dinner.

videos.title: Episode 10152 - Tuesday, May 7, 2013
videos.overview:
Dylan admits to Chelsea that he and Avery were once involved. Chelsea gives him the chance to walk away if he still wants to be with Avery. 

When Victor questions Abby about Victoria's intentions with Newman, Abby refuses to take sides. Later, Victoria asks Nick and Abby to help her buy enough Newman stock to kick Adam out of the company. Later, Victoria hires a P.I. to uncover dirt on Adam. She wants to know what he was going to reveal about Victor before he was shot.

Leslie asks Gus to tell her who Rose was. Tyler helps Gus as he struggles to breathe and they call the EMT's for help. 

Avery tells Nick that she wishes they could pretend that Dylan never came into town. They go to dinner and try to enjoy a night out.

videos.title: Episode 10153 - Wednesday, May 8, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack plans a romantic evening for Phyllis. Later, when Phyllis returns from her meeting, she's floored to see Traci. Traci informs them that she plans on staying in Genoa City indefinitely.

Carmine shows up at Lauren's and tells her he doesn't want things to stop between them. Lauren tells him that she wants her life and family back.

Lily and Cane struggle to make time for each other in the midst of their heavy work schedules. 

Leslie and Tyler struggle with Gus' death. Tyler confesses that he worried that one way or another that he would lose his father again. While planning Gus's funeral, Leslie thinks about inviting Rose.

When Fen tries to spend time with Summer, she tries to leave and he questions if she's meeting up with Kyle. Later at the gym, Fen confronts Kyle.

videos.title: Episode 10154 - Thursday, May 9, 2013
videos.overview:
When Michael confronts Lauren, she asks if he could blame her if she was having an affair. After a heated discussion, Michael goes out for a drink and sees Carmine tending bar. 

Chelsea tells Chloe that she's going to come clean to Dylan, and tell him that he's not the baby's father. Dylan shows Chelsea the drawing of the cradle he wants to make for the baby. Sparks begin to fly between them, and they share an intense kiss.

Kevin and Chloe try to agree that their stealing has to stop.

Nick tells Avery that he wants things to be the way they were before Dylan came to town. 

Sharon shows up to Adam's in a sexy maids outfit and they passionately kiss. When she leaves, Adam calls Victor to tell him that he found the money to buy out the public investors.

videos.title: Episode 10155 - Friday, May 10, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery finds Dylan at the bar, and gives him back his dog tags. Nick is floored when he sees them there together. 

Phyllis overhears Traci tell Jack her concerns about their relationship. Phyllis uses work as an excuse to get out of their dinner plans. 

At On The Blvd, a suspicious Michael questions Carmine. Later, Michael puts the pieces together and goes home to confront Lauren. 

Leslie and Neil visit the police station to get updates on the burglary in Neil's apartment. 

Fen tells Lauren that he loves Summer but knows that she doesn't feel the same way. Lauren tells him to not give up on her. Meanwhile, Summer asks Kyle to take her to the senior prom.

videos.title: Episode 10156 - Monday, May 13, 2013
videos.overview:
Nick and Avery promise never to be apart again. Later, Jack tells Nick to stop blaming Kyle for Summer's behavior. Later, Phyllis Summer to forget about Kyle. Fen asks Summer to the prom, but she turns him down. Summer determines to get Kyle to go to the prom with her. 

Paul and Alex review the details about the break-in at Neil's. Later, Alex arrests Chloe after he finds her with a lock box full of jewelry at Crimson Lights. Kevin insists that Chloe is innocent. 

Lauren tells Carmine she'll do anything she can to get Michael back. Michael remains uncertain if he can forgive Lauren.

videos.title: Episode 10157 - Tuesday, May 14, 2013
videos.overview:
Dylan shows Chelsea a sketch of a warehouse he plans to live in and turn into a nursery for their baby. 

Victoria and Billy discuss their plans to have another child. Later, Victoria arranges to meet up with her P.I. to see if he's dug up any dirt on Adam. Victor questions where Adam is getting the money to buy back Newman Enterprises. Meanwhile, Billy joins an old friend for a poker game.

Michael makes arrangements for Chloe's court hearing. Kevin decides that he has to confess in order to help Chloe.

Tyler tells Leslie that he's not planning to go to his father's funeral in Milwaukee. Later, Tyler visits his mother's grave and breaks down.

videos.title: Episode 10158 - Wednesday, May 15, 2013
videos.overview:
Someone watches Lily, Cane, Tyler, Leslie, and Neil after Gus' funeral. Leslie remains determined to learn about Rose.

Phyllis makes a strong effort to get along with Traci, but struggles as she watches the Abbott family bond. Avery tells Phyllis that she is taking things slow with Nick.

Adam and Victor are at an impasse when it comes to trust. As Victor leaves, Sharon shows up, and Adam passionately kisses her. 

While playing poker at the GCAC, Billy gets a call from Victoria. He says he'll be home in time for their special night, but an emergency at the restaurant is going to delay him. When he gets home, Victoria questions Billy.

videos.title: Episode 10159 - Thursday, May 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Michael cuts a work release deal for Kevin. Chloe wants to know how Kevin will make things up to her, and tells him that saying sorry won't cut it.

Nick assures Avery that things are alright with them and that he's been distracted about Summer. Meanwhile, Courtney tells Summer to invite Fen to prom so that Nick won't suspect that she is planning something with Kyle.

Victor tells Adam to cut Sharon out of his life. Meanwhile, Chelsea determines that Dylan is the father of her child and that no one will ever know the truth.

videos.title: Episode 10160 - Friday, May 17, 2013
videos.overview:
Phyllis tells Jack that they moved in together too quickly, and that she needs to move back into her place. 

When Fen comes by to pick Summer up for prom, she informs him that they're not going and that they have other plans. 

A fortune teller reveals to Kyle that love will find its way to him. Kyle receives an important text from Summer saying she's in trouble.

Michael tells Kevin that Carmine in sleeping with Lauren. Kevin kicks Carmine out of Crimson Lights. On his way out, Carmine runs into Lauren.

videos.title: Episode 10161 - Monday, May 20, 2013
videos.overview:
When Phyllis arrives at the penthouse, she's stunned to see Fen and Kyle fighting at Summer's party. Nick, Michael, and Lauren all come by to pick up their kids. Kyle tells Nick that he needs to ease up on Summer. Later, Phyllis tries to get Nick to give Summer some breathing room. When she leaves, Nick makes an important phone call. 

Jack gets upset that Traci feels the need to protect him from Phyllis. 

Abby figures out that it was Michael that tried to choke Carmine. Abby relays this information to Alex, while Paul overhears.

Sharon tells Dr. Watkins that she feels lost and lonely after having trusted Adam.

videos.title: Episode 10162 - Tuesday, May 21, 2013
videos.overview:
Summer invites Kyle to her photo shoot.

Chelsea brings Dylan a tool box as a housewarming gift. Later, Dylan invites Chelsea to a carnival and they end up talking with a fortune teller. 

Avery tells Adam that he's crossing the line when he asks about her broken engagement to Nick and her feelings about Dylan. Later, Adam thinks back about the last time he was with Chelsea and questions the timing of her pregnancy. 

After they have an important meeting, Jill tells Cane that he's too nice to be CEO.

videos.title: Episode 10163 - Wednesday, May 22, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam makes an important call to Chelsea's doctor. Meanwhile, Dylan reminds Chelsea that he'll always love their baby. Later, Dylan confronts Adam. 

Leslie tells Tyler he has to stop focusing on Lily. Later, another one of Neil's journal entries goes up online. Kevin hacks into the website and finds out where the IP address is coming from. 

Victoria tells Victor that their family will never be united while Adam is still involved. Victoria soon realizes her father doesn't trust Adam any more than she does. Meanwhile, Adam wants Billy to convince Victoria to concentrate on having a baby.

Chloe is frustrated at all the past due bills for Crimson Lights. She considers selling the shop.

videos.title: Episode 10164 - Thursday, May 23, 2013
videos.overview:
When Jack asks Billy to take Traci off his hands, Billy says that he can't and that is focused on having another child with Victoria. While Victoria gets stuck meeting with Victor and Adam, Billy decides to meet up with an old friend for a game of cards. Victor tells Adam that he's sure that Victoria and him can find some common ground. 

When Phyllis returns to the penthouse, she is told that her water and power will be out for weeks. Jack visits and asks Phyllis about when she'll move back in with him. 

Lauren ignores a text from Carmine as she tells Michael that she can't believe how she screwed things up between them. Later, Fen comes home and shocks Michael and Lauren.

videos.title: Episode 10165 - Friday, May 24, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria tells Chelsea that she knows her baby is Adam's, and that she's behind her wholeheartedly in keeping the truth from him. Later, Victoria asks Billy where he has been all night. Later, Chelsea visits Adam and tells him to stop calling her doctor. 

Dylan invites Avery over to the warehouse he bought. When he inquires about needing a lawyer, Avery agrees to help him. 

Michael and Lauren question who attacked Fen. Later, Michael confronts Carmine. 

Kyle picks up Summer for their date at On the Blvd. 

When Sharon visits Nick, he assures her that everything is fine with Avery. Later, they go to visit Cassie's grave and Nick reveals an important secret.

videos.title: Episode 10166 - Monday, May 27, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy tells Victoria that he doesn’t want to have a baby if she only sees it as a way to one-up Adam. Billy encourages Victoria to relax and try to focus on being happy away from Newman Enterprises. 

With the deal being closed for the Newman buy back, Victor asks Adam and Victoria to stop quarreling. When they can’t seem to reach an agreement, Victoria decides to leave the company.

Chloe considers selling Crimson Lights to Dylan. When she fails to tell Kevin, he gets upset and demands answers. 

Phyllis tells Nick that the best way to get through to Summer is by telling her the truth about Cassie’s death. Phyllis believes that Summer needs to know how losing Cassie affected her friends and family. When Dylan runs into Billy at the gym, he tells him that he’s buying his own business and won’t be available to work at On the Blvd.

When the fortune teller stops by Crimson Lights, she tells Chelsea that the father of her baby wants to be a part of it’s life. Meanwhile, Adam goes to the gym and finds Billy, Nick, and Dylan working out.

videos.title: Tuesday, May 28, 2013
videos.overview: this episode does not seem to have a CBS episode number as the previous episode is 10166 and the following episode is 10167

videos.title: Episode 10167 - Wednesday, May 29, 2013
videos.overview:
Anita is bothered that Chelsea refuses to tell Adam the truth about the baby and comments that his bank account is much larger than Dylan’s. Later, Anita realizes that Chelsea is falling for Dylan. 

Adam waits at the hospital while Dylan and Chelsea finish up with the doctor. When they leave, Adam approaches the doctor. Meanwhile, Dylan finds out that Chelsea and Billy have a child together.

When Noah visits Sharon, he finds her looking at an old photo album as she reminisces about the past. 

Neil is disappointed to hear that Leslie wants to leave Jabot. When Neil asks Devin to take over her job, Devon reveals that he’s considering a job offer in London. Roxanne gets upset that Devon hasn’t included her in his decision.

videos.title: Episode 10168 - Thursday, May 30, 2013
videos.overview:
While Jack and Phyllis enjoy an evening together, he tells her that he won’t press about her moving back in. When Traci apologizes to Phyllis, she is reluctant to believe her sincerity. 

Michael tells Paul that he wants to divorce Lauren, but he’s afraid of the repercussions it’ll have on Fen. Meanwhile, Carmine tries to slowly convince Fen that his parents should separate. Later, Phyllis confronts Carmine. 

When Traci tries to talk with Billy about his marriage to Victoria, Billy suspects that Traci might be running from problems of her own. Meanwhile, Nikki tells Victoria that she made the right decision to leave Newman Enterprises and she should focus on her happiness outside the company. Later, Adam confesses to Victor that he thinks Chelsea’s baby might be his.

videos.title: Episode 10169 - Friday, May 31, 2013
videos.overview:
Phyllis tells Nick that she hopes that being honest with Summer about the ripple effect caused by Cassie’s death will scare some sense into her.

Michael tells Lauren he’ll have divorce papers drawn up. Lauren asks Michael to give her 30 days to try and make amends.

When Cane tells Lily that he’s in Chicago, he secretly stays in town to plan a surprise party for her. Lily and Tyler have a drink at On the Blvd to toast the success of their campaign. Oliver stops by and tells them they’re crazy to end their partnership. 

Kevin tells Chloe that they don’t need to sell Crimson Lights and that he’ll find another way to make money. Meanwhile, Fen tells Carmine that he thinks his parents are hiding something from him.

videos.title: Episode 10170 - Monday, June 3, 2013
videos.overview:
Dylan meets up with Chloe to make the purchase of Crimson Lights official. Chloe gets upset at Kevin when he asks Dylan for an unreasonable amount of money for the business. Chloe rips into Kevin for not being someone that Delia will be able to look up to. Meanwhile, Alex gets frustrated at Kevin for skipping out on his community service. 

Lily apologizes to Cane for missing part of her surprise party and says she had no idea what he was planning since he told her he was out of town.

At Adam’s penthouse, Avery accuses him of throwing her towards Dylan, so he can get Chelsea back. When she leaves, Chelsea comes by and gets angry with Adam for interfering in her life. 

Noah and Tyler agree to be roommates.

videos.title: Episode 10171 - Tuesday, June 4, 2013
videos.overview:
Phyllis and Nick grab dinner after talking with Summer. Later, Avery tells Nick about the baby she and Dylan lost. 

Adam brings Chelsea to the hospital, and refuses to leave her side. When Dylan arrives, he’s told that Chelsea is fine, and that it’s her high blood pressure that caused the dizziness. Chelsea tells Adam that he needs to leave her alone. 

While packing up Crimson Lights, Chloe tries to cheer up Kevin with all the good things she says will come from working with Chelsea. 

When Gloria and Michael have a drink at the GCAC, she is shocked to find out that he’s moving out because Lauren cheated. Meanwhile, Carmine goes to see Lauren.

videos.title: Episode 10172 - Wednesday, June 5, 2013
videos.overview:
Chelsea wakes up at Dylan’s after having spent the night there. She mentions that she hasn’t slept that well in ages. Before she leaves for work, they share a kiss goodbye. Chelsea confesses to Chloe that she is falling in love with Dylan. 

Devon grills Tyler about staying out with Lily, and getting her tipsy the night of her surprise birthday party. Later, Lily confronts Neil about the recent blog post. Neil explains that the hacker has twisted his words. Kevin traces the blogger’s location to the public computer at the GCAC. 

Dylan comes to pick up his last paycheck from Billy, and informs him that he bought Crimson Lights. Billy calls his buddy Ken and asks to be dealt into a game.

videos.title: Episode 10173 - Thursday, June 6, 2013
videos.overview:
Michael tells Fen that he’s trying to work things out with Lauren. Meanwhile, Carmine sends Lauren chocolates. Later, Carmine tells Fen that he’s upset because a woman he’s been seeing has gone back to her ex. 

Devon questions Lily’s involvement with Tyler. 

Summer decides to attend GCU, and Noah can’t help but wonder if it has anything to do with Kyle. Later, Courtney takes Summer to get a prescription for birth control. 

Adam and Victor sign the paperwork to privatize Newman Enterprises. Avery sends a paralegal named Melanie over to finalize the paperwork.

videos.title: Episode 10174 - Friday, June 7, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy agrees to play cards with Ken, while at the same time, Victoria reminds him that they’re expected at Adam’s party. When she goes upstairs to tell the nanny that they’re leaving, Billy calls Ken to tell him that they’re going to have to pick up where they left off another night. 

Alex and Kevin continue their hunt for the blogger. Alex considers recommending Kevin for a job as a computer specialist once his community service is done.

Adam invites Melanie to the party at Victor’s. Victor announces that Newman Enterprises is solely owned by their family. Nick makes an important announcement about his future with Avery.

videos.title: Episode 10175 - Monday, June 10, 2013
videos.overview:
Nick receives an envelope from the paternity lab. Meanwhile, Phyllis finds birth control pills in Summer’s purse. Phyllis urges her to really think before doing anything. Kyle confides in Jack that he’s growing more attached to Summer, and enjoys spending time with her.

Nikki and Victor rent out a room at the club to celebrate Summer’s graduation. After the celebration is over and everyone is gone, Victor surprises Nikki with two tickets for their honeymoon. Later, Nick comes home from Summer’s graduation and rips open the envelope from the paternity lab.

Michael and Lauren bring Fen home from graduation to celebrate with Kevin and Paul. Fen tries to act like he’s grateful when Michael and Lauren give him a car. Fen receives a text saying he isn’t invited to the graduation party because he’s a loser.

videos.title: Episode 10176 - Tuesday, June 11, 2013
videos.overview:
Cane and Lily enjoy a dinner together as they discuss balancing family and work. Cane tells Lily that she shouldn’t have walked away from the campaign and that he was jealous of Tyler.

Alex asks Kevin if he knows anything about a recent robbery. Kevin vehemently denies having any involvement and Alex leaves. 

Nick opens the paternity test results and is shocked to learn that he’s not Summer’s father. When Noah asks him what’s wrong, Nick covers, saying he received an unexpected repair bill from the Underground. Later, Sharon tries to offer help to Nick. 

Phyllis tells Summer that whatever she has planned with Kyle can wait. Later, Summer and Kyle end their date with a kiss.

videos.title: Episode 10177 - Wednesday, June 12, 2013
videos.overview:
Nick goes to the Abbott mansion to tell Jack the truth about Summer. Nick can’t bring himself to reveal the truth, and quickly leaves. Phyllis confronts Nick and he tells her that he doesn’t know if he’ll ever be able to reveal the truth. Meanwhile, Kyle and Summer head out on a date. 

While Billy sits at the bar looking over his bets, he tells Jack he’s just taking care of some business. Kyle joins them after his date with Summer.

Lauren and Michael come back home after their first session with a marriage counselor.

videos.title: Episode 10178 - Thursday, June 13, 2013
videos.overview:
When Sharon confronts Adam about his social life, he accuses her of being jealous. 

Meanwhile, Chelsea feels the baby kick for the first time. She gets caught up in the moment and tells Dylan that she loves him.

Chloe tells Kevin that she is done living with a thief and covering for him. When Kevin asks if she is thinking of turning him in, Chloe takes off her wedding ring. Later, Chloe tells Chelsea that things are over between her and Kevin. Anita makes a phone call to a florist to order flowers for Chelsea in Adam’s name. 

When Billy checks the race results on his phone, Victoria asks him why he’s so excited. He covers and says he was just going over some receipts and that the restaurant made some money. Victoria suspects that something else is going on with Billy.

videos.title: Episode 10179 - Friday, June 14, 2013
videos.overview:
While Leslie and Avery discuss their partnership, Leslie reveals that she needs access to a safe deposit box her father left behind. 

Devon and Neil question how the blogger has managed to pick up old journal entries that correspond with what is currently happening in their lives. 

With everything going on at Newman, Nikki questions if Victor is still comfortable leaving Adam in charge of the company while they go on their honeymoon. Later, Adam makes a mysterious phone call. 

Chelsea tells Dylan that she loves him. Dylan later admits that he can’t live in the past, and he does love Chelsea. Meanwhile, Anita considers telling Adam about Chelsea and the baby. 

Cane hires Hilary as his new assistant. Hilary introduces herself to Lily and tells her she recognizes her as the face of Jabot.

videos.title: Episode 10180 - Monday, June 17, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria accuses Billy of having an affair with Chloe. Billy denies having an affair and admits that he fell back into gambling. 

Chloe figures out that Lauren had an affair with Carmine. Later, Chloe tells Kevin to return everything he stole and to volunteer at a homeless shelter.

Michael finds Fen passed out and he wakes him to ask if he’s drunk or high. Lauren overhears Michael tell Fen that he wants his marriage to work. Michael gets a text from a client, and has to leave. Later, Carmine comes over to visit Lauren.

Leslie reads over the letter that Neil wants to post to the blogger. Leslie realizes something the blogger said was in a letter that Rose wrote to Gus.

Phyllis and Nick decide to tell Summer the truth about the paternity test. Nick buckles, and ends up telling Summer that he’s worried about her and Kyle. When they’re alone, Phyllis asks Nick what happened.

videos.title: Episode 10181 - Tuesday, June 18, 2013
videos.overview:
Carmine kisses Lauren as Fen comes off the elevator. Lauren makes Carmine leave, and then explains things to Fen. He concludes that at one point they had an affair. Michael arrives and notices something is wrong. Lauren explains that Carmine showed up uninvited and initiated the kiss. Fen lashes out at Lauren, and leaves. 

Traci opens up to Jack about her problems with Steve. Meanwhile, Phyllis gets angry at Nick for not telling Jack the truth about Summer. Later, Courtney grills Summer as to why she and Kyle haven’t had sex yet.

videos.title: Episode 10182 - Wednesday, June 19, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe tells Chelsea that Kevin needs to change, and this is his last chance. Chelsea confesses to Chloe that Dylan told her he loves her.

Tyler and Devon argue when Devon finds out that Tyler moved forward on the campaign designs without him. Chloe calls Lily and asks her to help settle their argument. Devon confronts Lily about her feelings for Tyler. 

Billy calls Victoria and leaves her a message saying he wants to make things right between them. Later, Billy tells Dylan about his gambling problem and that he’s not going to play cards anymore.

Phyllis calls Nick to discuss how to fix things. Phyllis tells Jack that she needs to go to Chicago and the executive that was supposed to go with her is on vacation. When Jack offers to go, Phyllis suggests that Kyle go with her instead. 

Avery realizes that something is bothering Nick. Nick tells her that nothing will stand in their way of getting married.

videos.title: Episode 10183 - Thursday, June 20, 2013
videos.overview:
Michael wonders what will happen if he and Lauren can’t convince Fen that they’re committed to making their marriage work. Lauren suggests they follow their therapist’s advice and go on a date. 

When Kevin returns all the stolen items and asks Chloe to come back home, she tells him that she’s not ready yet. Abby accuses Chloe of being involved with Billy. When Chloe denies Abby’s accusation, Kevin wonders if something might be going on. Later, Chloe is shocked to discover that Victoria also thinks she’s having an affair with Billy. 

Neil receives a response from the blogger. Avery tells Leslie the court order went through, and she can now open the safe deposit box. Leslie finds Gus’s will inside the box.

videos.title: Episode 10184 - Friday, June 21, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam flirts with Melanie until he is distracted by Chelsea. Melanie compliments Chelsea on her designs, and congratulates her on the baby. Chelsea leaves, and Adam informs Melanie that Chelsea is his ex-wife. 

Billy brings Victoria to see Adam so he can confirm that he’s been gambling. Billy’s plan backfires, as Adam says Billy must have really screwed up if he was willing to use gambling as an excuse. 

Chelsea arrives at Dylan’s and notices a freshly painted wall this is slightly obscured by a sheet. Dylan distracts her and says she can see what it is after dinner. After dinner, Dylan pulls down the sheet to reveals a surprise for Chelsea.

Leslie and Neil inform Avery that Gus left half of his estate to his children and the other half to Rose Turner. Leslie finds a photo of Rose in Gus’s safe deposit box. Leslie thinks Neil should respond to the blogger with a mention of Rose. 

Lauren and Michael’s date is interrupted by the waiter bringing over a bottle of Champagne. Michael believes that Carmine ordered the bottle.

videos.title: Episode 10185 - Monday, June 24, 2013
videos.overview:
In Chicago, Kyle and Phyllis go over information for their meeting with a focus group. When Kyle steps out, Phyllis answers his phone when Summer calls. When Summer questions why Phyllis is in Kyle’s room, Phyllis says they are meeting about work, and that Kyle can’t talk because he’s in the shower. 

Sharon questions what is bothering Nick. Avery overhears, and wonders why Sharon is making herself so available to Nick. 

Kevin confronts Billy and asks if he’s sleeping with Chloe. Meanwhile, Chloe enjoys telling Adam that Chelsea is engaged to Dylan. Anita disapproves of Chelsea’s engagement to Dylan. Billy leaves Victoria a heartfelt message asking her to let him come home. 

Chloe accuses Kevin of avoiding the real problem in their marriage which is his stealing. 

Adam figures out that Sharon still thinks she might have a chance with Nick.

videos.title: Episode 10186 - Tuesday, June 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe refuses to fight with Kevin over whether or not she is having an affair with Billy. She sadly tells Kevin that their marriage is falling apart. Chloe tells him she’s going to draw up divorce papers. 

While Victoria believes that Billy is not having an affair with Chloe, she tells him that he needs to leave. 

Sharon tells Adam he is fooling himself if he really thinks he has moved on from Chelsea. Sharon visits Cassie’s grave and tells her how much she misses her.

Dylan tells Anita how much he loves Chelsea, and how he will provide Chelsea and the baby with everything they need. 

Avery tells Nick that she thinks he needs some space and that she can’t help him if he won’t open up to her.

Adam tries to get to know Melanie but she is reluctant to reveal anything. When she excuses herself, Adam takes the opportunity to go through her phone.

videos.title: Episode 10187 - Wednesday, June 26, 2013
videos.overview:
When Tyler tells Neil that he can’t work this way, Neil fires him. Later, Tyler tells Noah that Neil fired him because of his feelings for Lily. Meanwhile, the blogger taunts Neil, asking him what his children and grandchildren would think if they knew what he did. 

Jack worries about Traci and her marriage, but she doesn’t want to talk about it. Meanwhile, Kyle agrees to have drinks with Phyllis to celebrate his success with the focus groups. Phyllis stresses what little Kyle and Summer have in common. 

Avery asks Nick if he has changed him mind about telling her what is bothering him. Nick calls Phyllis and leaves her a message that it’s time for them to come clean about Summer.

videos.title: Episode 10188 - Thursday, June 27, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy tells Carmine that Victoria kicked him out for gambling. Carmine hands Billy a business card of a guy looking for a game. Later, Fen tells Carmine to stop texting him. 

Tyler accuses Devon of getting him fired. Meanwhile, Abby and Alex get into an argument at the police station. Later, Abby offers to buy Tyler a drink when she hears that he lost his job. 

Michael and Lauren try to enjoy watching a movie together. During dinner, they share a sweet kiss and work on rebuilding their relationship. 

Jill offers Hilary double her pay to divert projects to her instead of Cane. Lily comes clean with Cane, and tells him that Tyler is the reason she left the campaign. Lily tells Cane that she doesn’t have feelings for Tyler even though he may be attracted to her. 

Chloe and Kevin inform Delia that they are getting a divorce. Delia is pained by the news, but is assured that it has nothing to do with her. 

Fen passes money to a dealer in exchange for a bag of pills.

videos.title: Episode 10189 - Friday, June 28, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy confides in Jack about his gambling. Jack assures him that he will always be there for him.

Abby tells Victoria that she hopes she can work things out with Billy. Later, Billy comes to the magazine office to return a doll that Delia left behind. Chloe tells him that she has made a lot of bad decisions, but choosing him to be Delia’s dad was a good one. 

Adam and Melanie continue to flirt, and eventually make love. Adam tells Melanie that it was his idea to privatize Newman. Melanie doesn’t think it will be long before Victor is working for Adam. Adam heads to the shower and overhears Melanie make an important phone call.

Dylan asks Chelsea to move in with him. Chelsea admits to Chloe that she hates that the best relationship she has ever had is based on a lie. Meanwhile, Dylan reunites with his old friend Stitch. 

Phyllis succeeds in keeping Kyle and Summer apart by asking them to help her plan Jack’s surprise party.

videos.title: Episode 10190 - Monday, July 1, 2013
videos.overview:
Lauren gets a text from Carmine and she responds by telling him to leave her alone. Michael tells Lauren that he turned down a case where a woman, Eleanor, killed her husband and his mistress. Paul warns Carmine to stay away from Michael and Lauren. 

At Jack’s birthday celebration, Abby confronts Kyle about what is going on between him and Phyllis. Kyle receives a text from Summer saying that she and Jack are on their way to Jack’s surprise party. Later, Billy shows up drunk to the party. Meanwhile, Kyle tells Summer that they are moving too fast. Abby lays into Kyle when he tells her that he broke things off with Summer. 

Phyllis arrives at The Underground just as Nick reveals the truth to Avery.

videos.title: Episode 10191 - Tuesday, July 2, 2013
videos.overview:
Sharon watches as Summer gives Faith an early birthday gift. 

Victoria takes Johnny over to the ranch and tells her parents about Billy’s gambling, and that she is going to visit Reed for the fourth of July. Victor tells Victoria that he wants her to file for divorce. 

Kyle tells Abby that Phyllis kissed him, and it doesn’t mean anything. Abby tells Kyle that Jack should know that he kissed Phyllis. Summer tells Jack that Kyle dumped her and that she’s convinced that her mother had something to do with it. Meanwhile, Billy confides to Jack about Victoria leaving, and his inability to quit gambling.

Avery thinks Phyllis lied about the paternity test, but soon realizes that it was Nick’s doing.

videos.title: Episode 10192 - Wednesday, July 3, 2013
videos.overview:
Lauren prepares a romantic evening for Michael. Michael tells her that he never stopped loving her, but he needs time to find his way back to her. 

Noah tries to charm Courtney into telling him where Summer is. When Mason finds out that the Jabot campaign is now only going to focus on the female model, Noah offers him a job at the bar. 

Nick gets upset that Summer has left town because Kyle broke up with her. Later, Noah tells Nick that Summer is in Chicago. 

Chelsea meets Dylan’s friend Stitch. Stitch tells Chelsea that Dylan deserves to be happy after everything that happened.

videos.title: Episode 10193 - Thursday, July 4, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam and Victor tell each other how much the loyalty they have between them matters. Adam baits Melanie by asking her to look into a company that Victor already passed on, and to keep it between them. Later, Melanie calls Victor to update him on Adam’s plan. 

Tyler tells Leslie that Neil fired him. Neil and Tyler plead their side to Leslie, who ultimately agrees that Neil did the right thing. Leslie tells them that Rose died six years ago of a stroke. Neil receives another notice on his phone from the blogger. 

Chloe tries to cheer up Delia, but the only thing that puts a smile on her face is Kevin coming through the door. After Kevin leaves, Chloe realizes that Delia’s has a high fever. Chloe frantically calls Billy and leaves him a message. Billy comforts her and says everything will be fine with Delia. Billy surprises Delia with an impromptu 4th of July celebration. 

Nikki tells Billy that she doesn’t want to see her daughter hurt because of him. Billy begs Nikki to ask Victoria to give him one more chance. Victor tells Billy that he is and an addict, and that’s all he’ll ever be. Nikki blasts Victor for being so harsh about addiction. 

Alex wants Kevin to take him up on his offer to work for the police.

videos.title: Episode 10194 - Friday, July 5, 2013
videos.overview:
Cane and Lily take the twins to see the fireworks. When they come back home, Cane sets up a romantic evening for Lily. 

Chloe tells Kevin about Delia being in the hospital. When Kevin asks why she didn’t call him right away, Chloe reminds him that she and Billy are Delia’s parents. 

Melanie tells Victor about Adam’s plan to continue forward with the business deal he passed on. Victor tells her to proceed. Later, Abby reminds Victor that Victoria still loves Billy. Meanwhile, Adam confronts Melanie. 

Abby and Alex argue their differing views about money and work.

videos.title: Episode 10195 - Monday, July 8, 2013
videos.overview:
Sharon tells Jack about how she looks back at old pictures, and it’s like she’s still trapped in a time when Cassie was alive, and she was married to Nick. 

Lauren asks Michael if he is going to file for divorce now that their 30-day trial period is up. Michael tells her that he’s committed to making their marriage work. Michael tears up the divorce papers, and leads Lauren into the bedroom.

Fen comes to see Carmine with the hopes of scoring some drugs. Carmine turns Fen down and calls Lauren to warn her, but she hits the ‘ignore’ button on her phone. Carmine finds Fen passed out in the alley with a bag of white powder next to him.

Kyle admits to Abby that he shouldn’t have ended things with Summer, but doesn’t think calling her is a good idea. Abby thinks Kyle should tell Jack about the kiss he shared with Phyllis. When Jack overhears Kyle arguing with Abby. Kyle is forced to come clean about the kiss.

Courtney tells Kyle that Summer will come home if he tells her that he’s sorry. Courtney calls Summer to let her know that her parents are in Chicago looking for her. Phyllis and Nick look for Summer at a modeling agency in Chicago. Summer sends Phyllis and Nick a text informing them that she is heading back to Genoa City. Phyllis goes home and tells Jack that she needs to tell him something. Later, Nick finds Summer.

videos.title: Episode 10196 - Tuesday, July 9, 2013
videos.overview:
Chelsea is surprised to learn that Anita and Jeff are coming over to have dinner with her and Dylan. Anita is shocked at where Chelsea and Dylan live. Dylan hopes that Anita and Jeff can be happy for them. Later, Dylan brings up the connection between Chelsea and her mother. Meanwhile, Jeff wants the truth out of Anita about whose baby Chelsea is carrying. 

When Michael and Lauren rush to Fen’s hospital room, Michael accuses Carmine of giving Fen the drugs. Carmine says he saved Fen’s life. The doctor informs them that Fen’s condition is critical, and that they should talk to him, because familiar voices are helpful. Michael asks Fen how this happened. 

Phyllis comes clean and tells Jack that she kissed Kyle to break him and Summer apart because Summer is Jack’s daughter. When Jack blasts Phyllis for keeping this from him, she tells him she didn’t know until Nick told her. Meanwhile, Summer accuses Nick of lying in order to keep her away from Kyle. Nick assures her it’s true. Nick wants to take Summer home and she tells him that she doesn’t have a home or a family.

videos.title: Episode 10197 - Wednesday, July 10, 2013
videos.overview:
Kevin thanks Paul for his new job. Michael demands Carmine be locked up for trying to kill his son. Paul agrees to start investigating. Lauren sees Carmine outside Fen’s hospital room and blames him for putting Fen in the hospital. Carmine insists he had nothing to do with it. Paul takes Carmine down to the station for questioning. Later, Michael asks if Fen is sure Carmine gave him the drugs. 

Victor questions Adam about his love life. Later, Adam warns Melanie not to underestimate Victor. Victor gets Melanie to admit that she has been working with Adam. When Melanie offers to continue to work for Adam, he tells her that she failed at her task and is of no use to him. 

Leslie reads Neil one of Rose’s letters to Gus begging him not to cut her off. Neil learns that Rose died in a hospital in Evanston in 2007. 

Nikki explains to Victoria that Billy needs his family and that she should give him another chance. Victor comes home and tells Nikki about a fundraiser he wants to have for MS research. Meanwhile, Chloe talks to Billy about his addiction and says that she is on his side.

videos.title: Episode 10198 - Thursday, July 11, 2013
videos.overview:
Stitch encourages Dylan to tell Chelsea about his time in Afghanistan. Meanwhile, Chelsea asks Avery if Dylan ever talked about the war. Avery tells Chelsea that Dylan’s entire unit was killed and he was presumed dead. 

Phyllis tells Summer that they need to go home. Summer tells Phyllis that she doesn’t belong to anyone anymore. Phyllis promises Summer that she will be there for her every step of the way. Meanwhile, Nick tells Victor that Summer is not his biological daughter. Victor concludes that Summer is Jack’s daughter and gets upset that Summer is an Abbott. 

Neil sees Jill at On The Blvd, and invites her to have dinner with him. Lily greets them, and then goes to sit with Cane and Hilary while they go over contracts. Meanwhile, Neil receives a new message from the mystery blogger and recalls being in a bar in Evanston in 2007. 

Abby shows up at Noah and Tyler’s apartment. Tyler says he needs a break from old habits and surprises Abby with a kiss.

videos.title: Episode 10199 - Friday, July 12, 2013
videos.overview:
Dylan tells Chelsea about his time in Afghanistan.

Sharon brings Faith home and they have dinner with Nick. Faith wishes she could have her family together all of the time. Nick finally tells Sharon that Summer is not his daughter. Sharon tells him that he isn’t alone, and she will help him through this.

Phyllis tells Nick that he can’t fix this in one night, and needs to take a step back. Meanwhile, Traci tells Jack that there’s still time for him to be a father to Summer. Later, Jack admits to Phyllis that he is tempted to fall off the wagon. Nick shows up to see Jack. 

Kyle asks for Billy’s help in turning the restaurant into a romantic night for Summer. Billy hands him the keys and tells him to lock up when he’s done.

Summer gets a text from Kyle saying they need to talk. Summer walks into the romantic set up Kyle has created. Kyle explains that he wants to start over where they had their first date. Summer bursts into tears and tells Kyle they cannot ever date.

videos.title: Episode 10200 - Monday, July 15, 2013
videos.overview:
When Gloria blames Lauren for Fen’s overdose, Lauren tells her about Carmine giving Fen drugs. Michael gets that Carmine hasn’t been charged yet. Leslie breaks up an argument between Carmine and Michael and tells Paul to release Carmine.

When Faith wants to know why Summer is crying, Summer says they are tears of joy because Faith is in her life.

Avery tells Leslie that Nick is going through some things, but that’s all she can share. Avery finds a note from Sharon telling Nick she understands what he did and to call her anytime. Across town, Jack punches Nick and asks him to give him back the last eighteen years. Later, Summer breaks down in Jack’s arms. Meanwhile, Avery assures Nick that they can get through this together.

Carmine uploads a sex tape of him and Lauren.

videos.title: Episode 10201 - Tuesday, July 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Jeffrey tells Chelsea that he is going to keep her from making the biggest mistake of her life. Chelsea gives Jeffrey a check to stay quiet about her baby. 

Jack tells Phyllis that it still stings that Phyllis knew the truth about Summer before him and didn’t tell him. Jack and Phyllis decide they are going to get through this together. Meanwhile, Sharon dreams of her and Nick being back together.

Kyle accuses Nick of taking what he wanted and not caring about anyone else after Nick tries to explain that he really believed Summer was his. Later, Jack interrupts an awkward conversation between Kyle and Summer.

videos.title: Episode 10202 - Wednesday, July 17, 2013
videos.overview:
At On The Blvd, Billy tells Chloe that he was on his way to a meeting of Gamblers Anonymous. Chloe is relieved to discover that the guy Billy was talking with is his sponsor. Carmine approaches Michael and asks if he has seen any good videos lately. Billy warns Carmine not to fight his personal battles while at work. Carmine heads out to the alley to take out the trash and finds Michael waiting for him. 

Victor places a mysterious phone call telling the person on the other end of the line that he needs to see them right away about the Gala. Victor tells Adam that Melanie should be his guest at the gala. Adam says that won’t happen since Victor fired her. 

Phyllis accidentally informs Adam about Summer’s paternity. She tells Adam that no matter what, Nick will always be a better person than him. Meanwhile, Nick tells Victoria the truth about Summer’s paternity. Later, Phyllis tells Nick she went to see Michael because there might be some legal issues they need to address.

videos.title: Episode 10203 - Thursday, July 18, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria offers to arrange a visit between Billy and Johnny. Billy tells Victoria that he won’t let her down. 

Victoria asks Chelsea to get Chloe to stop hanging around Billy, or she’ll tell Adam about the baby. Dylan questions what is going on between Chelsea and Victoria. 

Alex catches Kevin watching a sex tape and tells him that he shouldn’t be doing that on a work computer. Kevin tells him he’s trying to shut it down. Lauren tells Paul about the tape, and he agrees to bring Carmine in for questioning. 

Lauren breaks up a heated confrontation between Michael and Carmine. Later, Paul shows up to arrest Michael for aggravated assault. Lauren confronts Carmine about having Michael arrested. 

Abby asks Lily and Cane to join Tyler and her while they enjoy a night out.

videos.title: Episode 10204 - Friday, July 19, 2013
videos.overview:
Phyllis and Jack agree to meet at the MS benefit. Phyllis and Avery share a rare moment as they talk about what a good father Nick is and how he didn’t set out to hurt anyone on purpose.

Summer enjoys a tea party with Faith, as Nick shows up. Summer tells Nick and Sharon that they can tell Faith whatever they want, but she isn’t going to say she isn’t her sister.

Nikki prepares for the Gala and tells Victor and Victoria that she wants Billy to be there. Victoria tells her parents not to focus on her marriage. Meanwhile, Jack tells Billy that he plans to propose to Phyllis tonight. Kyle sees Jack with the engagement ring he intends to give to Phyllis and congratulates his dad. 

Cane and Hilary discuss his upcoming trip to NY. Lily arrives and asks to speak to him alone.

videos.title: Episode 10205 - Monday, July 22, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy fires Carmine from On the Blvd. Later, Melanie agrees to Billy’s plan to file a suit against Adam.

Lauren tells Michael that Carmine will drop the charges if she gives him one last night together. Meanwhile, Raven and Fen head off together and Fen leaves his phone behind. Carmine lures Lauren to a cabin using Fen’s phone. 

Phyllis overhears Sharon admit that she made Nick believe that Jack is Summer’s father. Phyllis threatens to tell Jack, Nick, and Summer what Sharon did. Meanwhile, Summer tells Kyle that they are going to have to do everything they can to stay away from each other. 

Victor introduces Nikki to give her speech at the Gala. Phyllis attempts to call Jack, but he struggles to hear her because the crowd in the ballroom is too loud.

videos.title: Episode 10206 - Tuesday, July 23, 2013
videos.overview:
Cane and Lily referee a squabble between Charlie and Mattie. They enjoy an evening as a family and are reminded how lucky they are to have each other. 

Michael worries that he could go to jail while Carmine is free to attack his family. Meanwhile, Lauren confronts Carmine and demands that he give her Fen’s phone. 

Avery and Nick find Phyllis at the Gala and rush her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Sharon tells herself that what happened to Phyllis was an accident. Later, Noah goes to see Sharon and tells her about Phyllis. Dr. Costner gives Jack, Nick, and Avery important news about Phyllis.

videos.title: Episode 10207 - Wednesday, July 24, 2013
videos.overview:
Chelsea questions if anything is going on between Chloe and Billy. Later, Chloe tries to get Victoria to see that she doesn’t want Billy. 

Jack tells Nick that he should be the one to find Summer and tell her about Phyllis since she won’t answer her phone. Adam comes to see Jack and tries to console him. Nick tells Summer about Phyllis being in the hospital. 

At On The Blvd, Melanie brings Billy her document on the sexual harassment suit against Adam.

videos.title: Episode 10208 - Thursday, July 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Summer breaks down in Jack’s arms. Jack sits with Phyllis and says they have an amazing daughter. 

Abby reads the GC Buzz post that says Cane was spotted boarding a plane with a beautiful woman who is not his wife. Lily calls Cane and Hilary reveals that she is answering Cane’s phone while he’s in a meeting. Abby wonders why Cane didn’t tell Lily that he took Hilary with him. Lily insists that she and Cane trust each other and nothing can come between them. Meanwhile, Leslie tells Neil that the blogger must be watching them to get new information.

At the police station, Michael is denied bail. Jill stops by and tells him that Lauren and Fen didn’t come home last night. Paul offers to send a patrol car around. Kevin manages to track Lauren’s phone. Meanwhile at the cabin, Carmine asks Lauren to admit that their time together means something for her too. Lauren plays along and eyes a knife on the table.

videos.title: Episode 10209 - Friday, July 26, 2013
videos.overview:
Kevin thinks he knows where Carmine took Lauren. Kevin hacks into the police station system and puts in on lock down so Michael can escape. Later, Paul questions Kevin. Meanwhile, Lauren tries to get Carmine to trust her and let her go. 

Jack tells Phyllis that she fell and is at the hospital. Jack tells Avery, Nick and Summer that Phyllis is awake. Dr. Costner gives Phyllis a sedative, and tells her to rest. Meanwhile, the spirit of Cassie tells Sharon that Nick needs to hear the truth from her. Later, Summer realizes that the lipstick Sheryl gave back to her doesn’t belong to Phyllis.

videos.title: Episode 10210 - Monday, July 29, 2013
videos.overview:
While Leslie and Tyler catch up over coffee, Tyler brings up the bloggers latest post. Meanwhile, Neil tells Lily that he plans on stopping the blogger. Neil tells Leslie that he remembers that he met Rose in a bar in Evanston right after Drucilla died. Later, Lily sees Tyler and Abby kissing. 

In the cabin, Michael and Carmine face off as Lauren struggles to get free. As they struggle, Michael hits Carmine with a fireplace poker and unties Lauren. Paul arrives as they realize that Carmine has escaped.

Nick tells Avery that she will get the chance to talk to Phyllis now that she is awake. Meanwhile, Noah tells Summer that he doesn’t care what a DNA test says. Summer confides to Noah that she fell in love with Kyle and feels sick about it.

At the hospital, Phyllis struggles to tell Jack the truth about Sharon. Sharon arrives and watches as Phyllis gets more and more agitated.

videos.title: Episode 10211 - Tuesday, July 30, 2013
videos.overview:
After the bloggers latest post about Tyler and Lily, Abby freaks out and asks if the blogger knows something about the two of them that she doesn’t. When Lily leaves in frustration, Tyler admits that he was attracted to Lily at one point, but that doesn’t matter now that he has met Abby. 

Neil goes to the Evanston bar where he first met Rose. Neil tries to remember more by sitting in the booth they sat at. Leslie tells Neil that there may be a way to get his memories back and she suggests hypnosis. 

Melanie tells Billy that her sexual harassment claim against Adam is moving forward. Melanie says she intends on ruining Adam one way or another. 

Daniel arrives at the hospital and embraces Summer. After he sits with Phyllis, Daniel makes an important phone call. 

When Adam asks Jack if there’s anything he can do to help him, Jack says he is going to keep fighting for the woman he loves. Billy tells Adam the Abbott’s will be there for Jack. Later, Adam is shocked when he is served with papers for a sexual harassment suit.

videos.title: Episode 10212 - Wednesday, July 31, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery and Daniel argue over Phyllis while Jack tries to keep the peace. Nick tries to stick up for Avery and Daniel tells him he is no longer Phyllis’s husband or Summer’s father, so he needs to stay out of it. When Nick asks to speak to Daniel in private, Daniel says he will never understand Nick using Cassie’s death as an excuse for what he did. Avery and Jack assure Summer that they can get Daniel to let Phyllis stay in Genoa City. Meanwhile, Sharon worries that she could go to jail if Phyllis wakes up. 

Michael, Lauren, and Kevin question if Paul is any closer to finding Carmine. Paul assures them he has every available source looking for him. Later, Fen makes an important announcement to Michael and Lauren.

Hilary tires to clear up an important misunderstanding with Lily. Cane admits the blogger rattled him.

videos.title: Episode 10213 - Thursday, August 1, 2013
videos.overview:
Summer tells Nick that she doesn’t want to be separated from her mom, but wants her to have the best chance of waking up. Nick tells Avery that he thinks Daniel and Summer are right to want to send her to Georgia. Avery accuses Nick of taking Summer’s side to try and earn back her approval.

Adam warns Melanie not to start a battle she can’t win. When Adam leaves, Billy tells Melanie that she may have underestimated Adam. 

Victoria accepts Billy’s offer to move back home with Johnny. Later, Victoria asks Nikki know how Victor reacted to the sexual harassment suit filed against Adam. Nikki reminds Victoria that the battle for Newman always ends in heartbreak for someone.

Michael and Lauren visit Phyllis at the hospital. Later, Michael gets a shocking phone call about Fen.

videos.title: Episode 10214 - Friday, August 2, 2013
videos.overview:
Summer reassures Jack that he will not be alone and that Phyllis will wake up. Avery tells Daniel that she agrees with him about the plans for Phyllis. Meanwhile, Sharon slips into Phyllis’s room. Later, Jack pours his heart out to Phyllis and tells her that he’ll be waiting.

Melanie tells Paul that she wants to press rape charges against Adam. When Paul says that there is not enough proof to hold Adam, Melanie reveals damaging evidence. 

Billy asks Dylan to help build a copy of a bookcase that Victoria had as a little girl that was destroyed in the fire at the ranch.

Chelsea tells Victoria to stop blackmailing her with the truth about the baby. Later, Billy and Victoria watch as Adam receives shocking news.

videos.title: Episode 10215 - Monday, August 5, 2013
videos.overview:
When Noah questions if Sharon is off her medication, she tries to reassure him that everything is fine. Meanwhile, Nick tries to smooth things over between him and Avery before she leaves for Georgia. Noah comes to see Nick and expresses his concerns about Sharon. Nick promises to look in on Sharon after he drops Avery off at the airport. 

Hilary calls Cane and informs him that the blogger has struck again. Meanwhile, Neil tells Devon and Lily about the night he was on a bender and met Rose. 

Adam admits to having sex with Melanie, but maintains that he did not rape her. Adam asks Paul to have Melanie come in and accuse him to his face. Leslie arrives to defend Adam. 

Billy deduces that Melanie is making up the rape charges, and asks her to retract them. When Adam asks Melanie to recant her story and go away, Melanie tells Adam that she wants him to suffer. 

When Chelsea doubles over in pain, Dylan calls the doctor. At the hospital, Dr. Sterning tells Chelsea the baby would be fine if it was born now. Chelsea considers telling Dylan the truth.

videos.title: Episode 10216 - Tuesday, August 6, 2013
videos.overview: Victor summons Noah and Summer to the ranch. Victor reminds Summer that she’s still a Newman. Summer reveals that she convinced Jack to Phyllis go to Georgia for treatment.Adam tells Victoria that he’s not a rapist, but the target of a woman scorned. Later, Billy tells Victoria that he wants her to be happy, even if it means going back to Newman. Victoria claims there’s no chance of her going back to the company as long as Adam is there.Fen tries to deny stealing drugs from the hospital cart. Lauren worries that Fen’s rebellion was caused by her affair with Carmine.Dylan assures Chelsea that their baby will be fine. Chloe tells Chelsea that she shouldn’t tell Dylan anything about the paternity of her child. Later, Dylan tells Chelsea that he wants to get married before the baby comes.

videos.title: Episode 10217 - Wednesday, August 7, 2013
videos.overview:
When Billy asks Victoria out on a date, she still needs some time. Billy and Victoria celebrate when Johnny says, "Daddy” for the first time. 

Noah and Lily figure out that Tyler spent the night with Abby. Lily discovers that Tyler turned down the job in NY. Hilary watches a meeting between Tyler and Devon. Later, Devon asks Abby and Lily to help convince Tyler to return to Jabot. Meanwhile, Leslie figures out that Neil is scared to find out what really happened with Rose. Neil begins hypnosis. 

Sharon and Nick have breakfast together at the tack house. When Sharon tells Faith that they can make pancakes as a family, they’re interrupted by a phone call from Avery. Nikki and Faith come by with flowers. Later, Nikki questions what Sharon is doing with Nick. 

Courtney tries to get Summer to talk about her feelings. Noah urges Summer to stop pretending to hate Nick and show him how much she loves him.

videos.title: Episode 10218 - Thursday, August 8, 2013
videos.overview:
Chelsea tells Chloe that she’s worried she won’t be a good mother. Chloe tries to reassure Chelsea and says that she’ll be a great mother. Dylan brings Chelsea home to the loft for a big surprise. 

Victor is ambushed by a reporter outside Adam’s door. Inside, Adam hands Leslie a newspaper with a headline about the rape charge, and asks her to make it go away. Victor asks Adam if he’s guilty. Later, Adam reaches out to Chelsea and asks for help. 

Hilary stops by to see Cane, who is home sick. When Hilary spills soup on Cane’s shirt, he takes it off while. Jill walks in and demands to know what’s going on. 

Under hypnosis, Neil remembers going to a motel room with Rose and drinking. Later, Neil is horrified when Leslie reveals the date of Rose’s death.

videos.title: Episode 10219 - Friday, August 9, 2013
videos.overview:
Nick invites Sharon to go horseback riding. Meanwhile, Summer arrives to spend time with Faith. Sharon worries when Summer brings up the lipstick she found in Phyllis’ bag. Later, Summer bumps into Kyle. 

Jack and Avery get Phyllis settled in Georgia. Kyle tells Jack that Summer has closed herself off and needs help. 

Victoria tells Victor that he should toss Adam out of company. Later, Victoria admits to Nikki that she’s afraid to take Billy back. Meanwhile, Billy tells Victor that he can make the problem he is having with Adam go away.

Chloe, Anita, Jeffrey, and Stitch attend Dylan and Chelsea’s wedding. Dylan and Chelsea exchange rings. Later, the evening takes a shocking turn.

videos.title: Episode 10220 - Monday, August 12, 2013
videos.overview:
