Victoria tells Delia that she and Billy are still married, but he is staying with Jack for right now. Kevin brings Delia to work with him, and talks to Paul about how he wishes that he could get back together with Chloe.

Billy tells Victor he can make the charges against Adam go away, if Victor will kick Adam out of Newman and bring Victoria back. Victoria overhears their conversation and demands to know what they’re plotting. Meanwhile, Melanie has a heated confrontation with Adam.

Paul warns Michael and Lauren to be careful while Carmine is still out there. Fen thanks Paul for working out a deal where he can go to rehab. 

Dylan delivers Chelsea’s baby at the loft. The paramedics arrive and take Chelsea to the hospital. Later, Dylan and Chelsea name their baby.

videos.title: Episode 10221 - Tuesday, August 13, 2013
videos.overview:
Sharon brings over groceries for Nick and tells him she plans on taking care of him while Avery is gone. When Avery calls, Sharon offers up a distraction to get Nick’s attention. 

John warns Jack that he needs to give things time with Phyllis and has to figure out a way to deal with the pain. Meanwhile, Traci and Abby tell Summer that she doesn’t have to choose sides between the Newmans and the Abbotts. 

Abby flirts with Tyler, and asks him why Jabot let him go. Meanwhile, Lily isn’t happy to find Cane and Hilary working and laughing together on the couch. Later, Lily admits that the blogger is getting to her. Cane comforts her by letting her know that no one will come between them.

Leslie and Neil visit Alex and reveal their suspicions about the blogger. Neil messages the blogger, saying they should meet face to face.

Tyler asks Devon to admit that it was a bad move telling Neil to fire him. Later, Hilary approaches Devon and asks to hear about his time in the music business.

videos.title: Episode 10222 - Wednesday, August 14, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack and Summer go out for lunch, and run into Kyle who is on a date. Jack tells Summer that they can leave, but she says she can’t avoid Kyle forever. 

Victor gives a short statement to the press saying that Adam has his full backing, and the rape charges are a joke. Later, Victor calls his investigator and tells him to keep looking until he discovers Adam’s hidden agenda.

Neil receives a new blog post calling him a murderer, and saying that they won’t reveal themselves until he has lost more than they have. Cane apologizes to Hilary when she gets dragged into the latest blog post. Cane refuses to believe that Neil killed someone.

Adam asks Sharon to be a character witness for him. Adam and Nick exchange words before Adam leaves. Nick warns Sharon against supporting Adam in court. 

Tyler informs Noah that he’s going back to work at Jabot and that Noah can get his photographers assistant job back. Later, Tyler overhears the way Abby describes him to Traci and says he feels the same way about her.

videos.title: Episode 10223 - Thursday, August 15, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam questions why Dylan and Chelsea were able to bring their premature baby home so soon. Dylan dismisses Adam and reminds him that Chelsea won’t be a character witness for him. Meanwhile, Anita warns Chelsea that her lies will come crashing down on her.

Nick asks for Victoria’s help in getting Victor to back off Jack. Meanwhile, Nikki tells Jack that she hopes he’ll have a relationship with Summer despite any resistance from Victor. 

Sharon tells Adam that she doesn’t think he’s a rapist, but she won’t be character witness for him. Victor suggests Adam tend to some business out of town until the rape charges die down. 

Billy asks Victoria to give him some time at the house while he prepares a surprise for her.

videos.title: Episode 10224 - Friday, August 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Several of the residents of Genoa City receive postcards from Katherine, inviting them to the Chancellor mansion. Nikki tells Victor that she looks forward to seeing her dearest friend again. Lily and Cane head over to the mansion and discuss the postcards with Esther and Jill. Chloe and Devon join the group as they prepare to welcome Katherine home. Jill gets a call from Murphy who apologizes for being late and asks everyone to stay put until he arrives. Victor mentions that Katherine’s trip sounded like the kind of adventure you wait your whole life for. 

While Nick prepares a romantic evening to welcome Avery back home, Sharon calls him to say that Faith wants to see him. After the three of them enjoy playing games together, Faith falls asleep and Sharon enjoys the happy sight of the family she longs to have with Nick. Avery finds the note that Nick left. She grabs her keys and leaves.

Billy pulls out all the stops to prove to Victoria that he is committed to their relationship. Victoria is amused by his efforts, but wonders if this is really going to change anything. Billy asks her to let him make his case, and promises she won’t regret it.

videos.title: Episode 10225 - Monday, August 19, 2013
videos.overview: Murphy arrives and informs everyone at the Chancellor mansion that Katherine won’t be returning with him. Murphy explains that Katherine knew she was going to die, but didn’t want to tell anyone the real story of what the doctors said after her surgery. After Murphy tells everyone that Katherine died peacefully in her sleep, he gives Nikki a letter to read from Katherine. Jill gets upset and feels she was robbed of the chance to say goodbye to Katherine. Later, everyone recalls different memories of their times with Katherine.Nick welcomes Avery back home as a frustrated Sharon watches. Noah stops by to see Sharon and notices the speeding ticket and questions Sharon about it.Later, Sharon interrupts a romantic moment between Nick and Avery. When Sharon leaves, Avery tells Nick that she wants to get married right away.

videos.title: Episode 10226 - Tuesday, August 20, 2013
videos.overview: Jill goes to Jack to tell him about Katherine. They reminisce and discuss what her loss will mean to everyone Genoa City.Michael and Lauren bring Paul a flower box with eleven dead roses that contain a note from Carmine. Paul assures them they will find him. Laura receives a phone call from Jack telling her about Katherine. Michael tells Lauren to go be with Jill.Avery wants to move forward with marrying Nick. Meanwhile, Sharon tells Noah that she ran the red light rushing home to Faith, and that she drove across town because there was an accident near the cemetery. Noah gets a call from Nick asking him to be his best man and that the wedding will take place in a week. Later, Cassie tells Sharon that she needs to pull it together before people find out the truth.Kyle tells Summer that he is going to make thing easier by moving out of the Abbott mansion. Summer says she needs to stay in Phyllis’s apartment because it’s the only place where she doesn’t feel torn between two families. Later, Avery asks Summer to be her maid of honor.Jill talks to Katherine’s picture asking how can she do this to her. Lauren stops by to comfort Jill.

videos.title: Episode 10228 - Wednesday, August 21, 2013
videos.overview: Jack reads Katherine’s obituary to Billy and Abby. Later, Billy tells Jack and Abby that he and Victoria are getting back together. After Billy heads out, Nikki stops by to see Jack and they reminisce about Katherine.Victor vows to make things right with his family and confides in Victoria that he is going to make sure that Jack is never a father to Summer. Later, Victoria tells Victor that she and Billy are back together.Tyler tells Devon he will come back to Jabot if he hires Noah as his photographer.Chelsea and Dylan bring Connor home from the hospital. Dylan compares a photo of himself as a baby to Connor and says he doesn’t look anything like him.Later, Chelsea receives a call from Adam asking her to meet him. Devon asks Summer if she is ready to come back to work. Later, Jack tells Summer he is proud of her as they discuss her next move.

videos.title: Episode 10229 - Thursday, August 22, 2013
videos.overview: Chelsea tells Adam she no longer comes running when he calls. Dylan tells her that Adam probably wants her to be a character witness for him. Later, Adam stops over to ask for Chelsea’s help. When Connor starts crying, Adam picks him up and unknowingly meets his son for the first time.Neil reveals that he was able to get into Ann’s old apartment in London. Neil tells Kevin that he found a Wisconsin phone number that Ann frequently called. Kevin traces the number to a corporate cell phone registered to Newman Enterprises.Cane and Lily work from his house. Later, Lily questions why Cane smells like Jabot perfume. Meanwhile, Hilary meets up with an unexpected partner.Sharon tells Nick that she appreciates his friendship and isn’t asking for anything more. Later, Faith tells Nick that she doesn’t want him to marry Avery.

videos.title: Episode 10230 - Friday, August 23, 2013
videos.overview: Nick confronts Sharon and wants her to help make Faith understand that they are never getting back together. Sharon talks to Cassie and tries to come up with a plan. Later, Avery tells Sharon to back off.Dylan understands that Chelsea feels bad for Adam, but says that he brought this on himself. Connor starts coughing, and Dylan and Chelsea take him to the hospital.Esther gives Jill a sealed envelope from Katherine. After Jill reads the letter, she gets an idea and tries to open the safe in the wall. Jill calls for Esther to help her with the combination.Adam proposes the idea of Newman Enterprises taking over Chancellor Industries. Victor tells Adam that he will not dance on his friend’s grave.

videos.title: Episode 10231 - Monday, August 26, 2013
videos.overview:
Before Victoria leaves to help Nick put together the wedding, she makes Billy promise that he won’t use any power tools while building the bookcase. When Chloe comes to pick up Delia, Billy hits his thumb with the hammer. Delia says that Billy’s thumb won’t be better until Chloe kisses it. Chloe leans down to obey her daughter’s request just as Victoria comes back home.

Chelsea explains to Chloe that Adam asked her to be a character witness and that he doesn’t deserve to go to prison. Chloe argues that Chelsea deserves a happy life, and with Adam out of the way she can have one. Later, Chelsea defends Adam to Melanie, telling him that no matter how awful he is, he is not the monster she is accusing him of being. Later, Melanie makes an important decision about the case. 

Adam tells Jack that Leslie wants him to cut a deal, but he is not going to admit to rape for lighter charges. When Adam wonders if it is time to cut his losses and leave Genoa City, Jack tells him that running will only make things worse. 

Jill and Esther argue over whether or not Katherine would want Jill to have the combination to the safe. Later, Jill realizes the combination and finds an important gift from Katherine inside.

videos.title: Episode 10232 - Tuesday, August 27, 2013
videos.overview:
Michael comforts Lauren after she has a nightmare about Carmine. Alex gets a lead that Carmine rented an apartment in Chicago, but Kevin thinks it’s a set-up. Kevin makes an important discovery about Carmine’s whereabouts. Later, Carmine puts his plan into motion.

Hilary reminds Mason that she wants to cause the Winters family pain. She uploads a scandalous photo to GC Buzz. Later, Neil comes to see Mason and asks if he knew Ann Turner while working at Newman Enterprises. Lily tells Devon that Hilary is after something. Devon tells her to hold off until she talks to Cane. 

Summer finds Victor and Jack arguing. Nick arrives as Summer says she wishes she wasn’t an Abbott or a Newman. 

Cane and Esther discuss the significance of the picture that Jill found in the safe.

videos.title: Episode 10233 - Wednesday, August 28, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery worries that Faith is unhappy about her wedding to Nick wedding. Nick tells Avery that Sharon is going to help talk to Faith.

Mason tells Neil that he doesn’t remember Ann Turner or ever getting a call from her, but he will get a list of employees in reception for him. When Neil leaves, Mason warns Hilary about Neil’s curiosity. 

Hilary tells Cane that Devon is accusing her of trying to come between his marriage to Lily. When Cane goes home and finds Devon and Lily talking about the blogger, Devon assures Cane that Hilary is painting him to be the bad guy. When Devon and Lily tell Cane their suspicions about Hilary, Cane said it would only make sense if Hilary is actually Ann Turner. 

Kevin figures out that Carmine scanned a picture of an I.D. badge for a maintenance worker of the crew from Lauren and Michael’s building. Meanwhile, Lauren is shocked to see Carmine in her apartment. Michael and Carmine face off and Lauren pulls a gun on Carmine. 

Sharon explains to Faith that Nick is going to marry Avery and she needs to accept that. Faith doesn’t think Avery can make him happy the way Sharon can.

videos.title: Episode 10234 - Thursday, August 29, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery reveals her fears about the wedding to Victoria. Victoria comforts her and says that she’s stuck with Nick and his insane family, and the wedding is going full steam ahead.

Summer tells Courtney that she called her to say goodbye. Nikki stops by to talk with Summer about understanding how stubborn Jack, Nick and Victor can be and says that losing Katherine has taught her that you can’t take people for granted. Later, Nikki tells Nick that she thinks Summer is going to leave town. Meanwhile, Tyler and Noah run into Courtney who flirts shamelessly with Noah. 

Adam makes a mysterious phone call to his partner. Victor agrees to give Adam’s idea about taking over Chancellor some thought if Adam will reveal the name of his secret investor.

videos.title: Episode 10235 - Friday, August 30, 2013
videos.overview:
Jill notices that in the sketch of Katherine, she is holding a copy of Pride and Prejudice. Jill pulls out a copy of the book from the shelf, and a bookmark with the initials G.R. falls out. Jill questions what Katherine’s first husband, Gary Reynolds, has to do with this. Chloe mentions the necklace in the sketch and how she has never seen it before. Esther informs them that the necklace was from Katherine’s first husband, Gary. 

Jack tells Summer that her going to Georgia for a while to see Phyllis is a good idea. 

Adam makes an important call to his mystery investor. 

Dylan inspects the bookcase that Billy made and jokingly says that he should start over. Billy takes pride in the work that he completed with Delia. 

Chelsea is confident that helping Adam get the rape charges dropped was a good idea and that he’ll still keep his distance and stay out of her life. Later, Chelsea and Dylan take Connor in for his check-up. The doctor informs them that Connor is likely to develop Retinitis Pigmentosa and could eventually go blind. The doctor shocks Chelsea when he informs them that the disease is inherited from a parent.

videos.title: Episode 10236 - Tuesday, September 3, 2013
videos.overview:
Paul welcomes his brother Todd back to Genoa City. They talk with Kevin and Todd comments that Katherine must be proud of him now that he’s on the right side of the law. Later, Nina arrives and tells Paul that she received a letter from Katherine.

Danny rehearses his song in the park for Katherine’s memorial service. Nick tells Avery that the beauty of the park has just solved one of their problems. Meanwhile, Nikki tells Jill that she did a good job with all of the preparations for the service. As more people gather, Chloe recalls a fond memory of a conversation with Katherine. Lily and Cane say hello to Amber Moore. Devon thinks back to when he first found out Katherine was his grandmother. Father Todd tells everyone that it’s time to celebrate the life of the great Katherine Chancellor.

videos.title: Episode 10237 - Wednesday, September 4, 2013
videos.overview:
Jill recalls her rocky history with Katherine and how through it all they learned to love each other.

Murphy gives Paul a letter from Katherine. Todd reads a favorite poem of Katherine’s and everyone lays a flower near the urn and says their final goodbyes. Later, Murphy reveals the official dedication of Chancellor Park.

Nick tells Avery that the park would be a perfect place for them to get married. 

When Paul reads Katherine’s letter, he takes her advice to heart and surprises Christine.

Jill and Nikki sit together and laugh over how they got along so well. Later, everyone gathers back at the Chancellor mansion as Murphy announces that soon they will be reading Katherine’s will.

videos.title: Episode 10238 - Thursday, September 5, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam accuses Victor of having him followed and planting a recording device in his house. Victoria questions what Adam has up his sleeve. Victor realizes that losing Adam as a business partner could also mean losing him as a son. 

Jack knows he has to back up and give Summer space, but he doubts that Victor will do the same. Billy warns him that going to war with Victor is dangerous. Adam tells Jack that Victor bugged his office and is having him followed. 

Chelsea reveals Connor’s diagnosis to Anita. After Dylan leaves, Chelsea tells Anita that Connor inherited the eye disease from Adam. Anita promises to help Chelsea keep Adam from finding out. 

Meanwhile, Dylan stops by On the Blvd and tells Billy about Connor’s illness as Adam overhears their conversation.

videos.title: Episode 10239 - Monday, September 9, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam has a heated confrontation with Chelsea about her lies about Connor. When Chelsea tries to get Adam to leave, Dylan comes in demanding to know what’s going on. Adam says that Chelsea will fill him in. Meanwhile, Billy discovers that Victoria knows Adam is Connor’s father.

Jack wonders if Victor is onto his deal with Adam. Victor accuses Jack of kidnapping Summer. Jack explains that Summer went to see Phyllis and is staying with Daniel. 

Lily and Cane stage a fight for Hilary to see. Hilary tells Cane that she overheard some of the fight and wishes there was something she could do to help. Cane tells Hilary that he wishes that Lily could be as understanding as she is. Hilary shocks Cane and kisses him.

videos.title: Episode 10240 - Tuesday, September 10, 2013
videos.overview:
Cane pulls away from Hilary after she kisses him. She encourages him to talk to Lily and work out their problems. Meanwhile, Lily and Devon see a new post on GC Buzz of Cane and Hilary kissing. 

Sharon brings Nick a wedding gift. Nick notices that Sharon has a troublesome drawing of a bride and groom that Faith drew. Later, Cassie asks Sharon if Faith’s drawing made enough of an impression to stop the wedding. 

Adam visits Avery about suing Chelsea for custody of Connor. Adam explains to her that Connor is his son and has the same eye disease that he had. Adam insists that they get a paternity test done. Chelsea tells Dylan that Adam overheard him telling Billy about Connor possibly losing his sight. When Dylan continues to question her, Chelsea breaks down and is forced to admit that she lied about Connor’s paternity. Chelsea begs Dylan not to abandon her and the baby. 

Devon receives a phone call from Murphy about the reading of Katherine’s will.

videos.title: Episode 10241 - Wednesday, September 11, 2013
videos.overview:
Nikki decides to stay home while Victor heads to the Chancellor mansion for the reading of Katherine’s will. Nikki calls Paul and tells him that she needs to see him as soon as possible. Nikki reveals a shocking secret about her past to Paul. 

Friends and family gather at the Chancellor mansion for the reading of Katherine’s will. Jill, Esther, Kevin, and Chloe fantasize about inheriting Katherine’s fortune. Jill is unnerved by Katherine’s final wishes. Meanwhile, Hilary asks Mason to get close to Devon and suspects that Katherine may have left him a lot of money in her will. Later, Hilary begins to suspect that Lily and Cane are trying to pull a fast one on her and she plots to turn the tables on them.

videos.title: Episode 10242 - Thursday, September 12, 2013
videos.overview: Faith refuses to get dressed for the wedding until her doll, Miss Patsy, can be found. Nick let’s her open a gift from Avery, which is the new doll she has been asking for. Faith tosses it aside and says she doesn’t want a new doll. Faith runs to Sharon’s house and declares that she hates Avery. Meanwhile, Leslie asks Avery if part of her is still in love with Dylan. Avery gives herself a pep talk and decides against calling Dylan.While Billy and Victoria help set up for Nick and Avery’s wedding, Billy is reminded of all the times he married Victoria. The two declare their love for each other, as Abby and Tyler catch them in this tender moment. Abby and Tyler congratulate Billy and Victoria on or their renewed affection. Later, Leslie asks Tyler if things are getting serious between him and Abby. Nick waits at Chancellor Park without Avery, and tries to reassure the wedding guest as well as himself that Avery is on her way. Meanwhile, Avery is about to leave for the wedding, but stops when she finds a heartbroken Dylan sitting outside her door.When Chloe tells Chelsea to fight for her family, Chelsea says she does not know how to without Dylan and that losing Connor to Adam will kill her. Chloe tries to convince her that if the case goes to court, Adam will lose.

videos.title: Episode 10243 - Friday, September 13, 2013
videos.overview: When Dylan realizes that Avery is late for the wedding, he tells her to go ahead and get married. Meanwhile, Sharon tells Nick that she’s there for whatever he needs. She embraces him, but over her shoulder, Nick spots Avery who realizes that everyone has gone home.Jack tells Adam the only thing that matters now is Conner and that he needs both of his parents. Meanwhile, Chelsea decides that she has to talk to Adam. Adam gets Chelsea to admit that the baby is his. Later, Adam meets with Leslie and says he wants fully custody of his son.Victor meets with his operative who tells him that Fish Hook is a poker term. Victor realizes that Fish Hook is another name for a Jack.Nikki calls Paul and asks for his help.

videos.title: Episode 10244 - Monday, September 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy, Victoria, and Delia rehearse for Delia’s school play, leading to a warm family moment.

Victor confronts Jack about being Adam’s silent partner. Jack tries to make Victor see that he was helping Adam get closer to his father. Later, Adam tells Victor that he regrets all that he has done for him and that he’ll be a much better father to his own son.

Avery explains to Nick that she was late to their wedding because of Dylan. Meanwhile, Chelsea has a shocking encounter with Dylan.

videos.title: Episode 10245 - Tuesday, September 17, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack tells Kyle that he’s worried about Summer getting caught in the middle of his war with Victor. Later, Jack tells Summer about how he tried to help Adam. 

Adam asks Sharon if there is any chance of them getting back together. Later, Noah questions Sharon’s intentions with Nick. 

Chelsea goes to the police station and asks Alex to help her find Connor. Meanwhile, Adam thinks Chelsea sent the baby with Dylan to keep the baby from him and is determined to find his son.

Paul and Nikki set out to locate the church where Nikki gave birth.

videos.title: Episode 10246 - Wednesday, September 18, 2013
videos.overview:
Jill tells Michael that she needs a lawyer to contest Katherine’s will. Jill rants about how Katherine only left her half of the house and a worthless music box. Lauren, Esther, and Michael convince Jill to figure out the mystery behind the music box.

Nikki and Paul visit a church in Winnetka. Nikki tells Father Martin her story as well as the child’s date of birth. 

Devon tells Neil that Katherine left him an inheritance of $2.4 Billion. Neil warns him not to let the money go to his head.

Hilary tells Mason she is going to hurt Neil’s daughter in the worst possible way. Later, Lily calls Cane, warning him that Hilary might be on her way to see him. Cane invites Hilary to lunch.

videos.title: Episode 10247 - Thursday, September 19, 2013
videos.overview: Adam pounds on Avery’s door demanding to know where Dylan is. Meanwhile, Chelsea tells Anita about her concern with Dylan’s flashbacks of the war. Later, Avery finds Dylan at the cabin.Abby asks Lily about the new photos of Cane kissing Hilary. Lily reveals that Hilary is the one behind the GC Buzz posts. Meanwhile, Hilary puts a twisted plan into motion to hurt Cane and Lily. Later, Cane turns the tables on Hilary.Sister Clare recognizes Nikki and tells her that her child grew up well. Sister Clare says that she found a home for the baby in the congregation.

videos.title: Episode 10248 - Friday, September 20, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery tries to calm Dylan when she realizes he is experiencing post-traumatic stress. Adam and Chelsea arrive while Avery works to reassure Dylan and talk him down. Dylan realizes where he is and gives Connor back to Adam. Adam and Chelsea leave with Connor while Avery stays to comfort a distraught Dylan. 

Sharon and Dr. Watkins discuss her issues. She is convinced things with her and Nick are headed in the right direction. When Dr. Watkins questions how Sharon has been doing and if she is taking her medication, Sharon insists that she is fine and doesn’t need the pills. 

Jack and Victor meet to discuss their next steps with Newman Enterprises. Jack offers to find someone that Victor and Adam approve of to buy him out of Newman. In return, Jack asks that Victor give Adam a break. Victor suspects Jack wants something else.

Noah and Courtney bump into each other in Chancellor Park. Noah enjoys getting to know her as they start to flirt with each other.

videos.title: Episode 10249 - Monday, September 23, 2013
videos.overview: Paul urges Nikki to reveal the truth about her past to Victor.Sharon comforts Nick as he struggles with the end of his relationship with Avery. Later, Nick tells Faith that he’s not getting married to Avery. Meanwhile, Dylan and Avery go back to her apartment and she reveals that she and Nick separated.Chelsea convinces Adam that the baby should stay with her, but Adam has one condition; Chelsea and the baby move in to his penthouse.

videos.title: Episode 10250 - Tuesday, September 24, 2013
videos.overview: Adam tells Jack that Chelsea and Connor are moving in with him. Jack and Adam have an important meeting with Victor. Later, Victor invites Noah to come work at Newman with him and Victoria.Abby and Traci inform Kyle that they are moving into the Abbott mansion. Abby and Traci book massages and are in for a surprise when Tyler stops by. Later, Abby tells Tyler that she loves him.Summer tries to decide if she should go to Los Angeles to model and escape all of her family craziness in Genoa City. Summer asks Courtney to come with her, but Courtney doesn’t want to leave Noah.Nikki gets a call from Victor asking how her trip is going. Father Martin and Sister Clare arrive and share important information about the woman who adopted Nikki’s son.

videos.title: Episode 10251 - Wednesday, September 25, 2013
videos.overview: Victoria calls Billy while she is out of town on business and tells him she’ll be home soon.  Meanwhile, Kevin and Chloe talk with Delia about her upcoming performance in the play as Billy arrives with a surprise for Delia. Adam tells Chelsea that he isn’t sure she can properly care for Connor after what happened with Dylan.  Later, Chelsea and Adam bring Connor to the doctor for an important appointment. Hilary tells Mason that she is confident that Cane’s marriage will soon be a distant memory.  Meanwhile, Lily and Cane tell Leslie and Neil that they finally have proof that Hilary is the blogger.  Neil shocks everyone when he says he doesn’t want to press charges. Dylan meets with Dr. Bellamy and tries to explain to him what happened in Afghanistan.

videos.title: Episode 10252 - Thursday, September 26, 2013
videos.overview: Jack confronts Victor after he sees a news story that says Adam is running Newman Enterprises into the ground.  Jack questions if Victor would rather see Adam running the company or have it destroyed.  Later, Jack discovers that Newman Enterprises stock is plummeting.  Jack tells Adam that the only solution is for him and Victor to reach a compromise. Chelsea watches Adam sings to Connor and enjoys seeing them bond.  Meanwhile, Dylan tells Stitch that he needs a lawyer because he has to end his marriage to Chelsea. When Carmine is transferred to the courthouse jail, he tells Kevin to give his regards to the family.  Alex tries to reassure a frustrated Kevin who worries that Carmine is acting like he’ll get away with what he has done to Michael and Lauren.  Later, Alex receives a phone call that Carmine managed to escape during his transfer!  Alex breaks the bad news to a horrified Michael and Lauren. Avery and Sharon have a heated argument about their relationship with Nick.

videos.title: Episode 10253 - Friday, September 27, 2013
videos.overview: Alex assures Michael and Lauren that they’ll find Carmine.  Michael insists that Carmine is found before Fen comes home from rehab.  Paul surprises Nikki with her son’s adoption file.  Paul suggests she tell Victor the truth, but she doesn’t want to worry him.  Paul decides to open the adoption folder and is surprised by what he sees.  Later, Victor tells Nikki important news about his plans for Newman Enterprises. Stitch brings a can of paint to the loft and suggests that paint over the wall with “Will you marry me” written on it.  Later, Stitch tells Dylan that he’s going to be working at Genoa City Memorial Hospital.Nick walks in on Sharon and Avery arguing and asks what’s going on.  Avery says she just came to pick up her things and is leaving.  Sharon says she and Faith stopped by to surprise Nick with lunch, but Nick says he doesn’t want her doing things like that anymore.

videos.title: Episode 10254 - Monday, September 30, 2013
videos.overview: Billy admonishes Jack for getting involved in Adam’s scheme.  Later, Jack asks Summer if she’s thinking about leaving town to pursue a modeling career.  Billy goes back home and enjoys a surprise from Victoria. Nick and Dylan have a heated confrontation in Chancellor Park .  Meanwhile, Adam is surprised when Chelsea says that he doesn’t deserve what Victor is doing to him.  Later, Dylan gives Chelsea back the four leaf clover she had given him.  He tells her to give it to Connor because he’ll need the luck.Sharon tells Cassie that she is concerned that everything she did for Nick was for nothing.  Cassie assures her that she and Nick are meant to be together.Avery visits Phyllis in Georgia and pleads with her to wake up.

videos.title: Episode 10255 - Tuesday, October 1, 2013
videos.overview: Noah assures Nick that he knows what he is getting into by working with Victor.  Nick tells Noah that he doesn’t want him turning into another version of Adam.Nikki runs into Paul who has important information for her about the adoption of her child.  Later, Nikki is troubled when Victor insists that anyone who abandons a child doesn’t deserve to be a mother.Lily tells Cane that Hilary isn’t going to stop trying to hurt them.  Meanwhile, Neil goes to see Hilary and asks her to stop hurting the people he loves.  Hilary turns the tables on Neil and takes things too far. Dylan tells Stitch that he’s leaving Genoa City.  Meanwhile, Leslie asks Avery if she’s in love with Dylan.

videos.title: Episode 10256 - Wednesday, October 2, 2013
videos.overview: Victoria tells Chloe that she is glad she forgave Billy.  Billy and Victoria celebrate being back on the right track.  Meanwhile, Kevin and Alex go on a stakeout searching for Carmine. Fen surprises Michael and Lauren by being able to get a special pass out of rehab to see Lauren get her Businesswoman of the Year award at the Athletic Club.  Gloria introduces Lauren to the audience as Carmine lurks around the club plotting his next shocking move. Dr. Costner asks Nikki if she has been dealing with a stressful situation lately.  Later, Nikki meets Stitch who encourages her to reduce her stress.  Meanwhile, Paul manages to get new information about the person who adopted Nikki’s baby.

videos.title: Episode 10257 - Thursday, October 3, 2013
videos.overview: Nick comes home to find that Faith made him a collage of a picture of him with her and Sharon.  Nick shows it to Sharon and wants to make sure that she’s not encouraging Faith.  Later, Nick and Avery have a tense discussion about their relationship.  Nick asks Avery if she’s moving on with Dylan. Victor and Adam have a heated meeting about the state of Newman Enterprises.  On his way out, Victor runs into Chelsea and Connor.  Later, Chelsea brings Connor to Adam and they realize he’s running a high fever. Lauren’s award ceremony takes a shocking turn as everyone searches for Carmine.

videos.title: Episode 10258 - Friday, October 4, 2013
videos.overview: Cane receives a call from Victor who wants to meet with him.  Victor tells Cane that this meeting is about his plans for Chancellor and how he fits in. While Hilary revels in her plot against Neil, Mason thinks it might be time to go after some money.  Devon arrives and makes Hilary a surprising offer.Chloe and Kevin search for Fen while Michael and Lauren take action.

videos.title: Episode 10259 - Monday, October 7, 2013
videos.overview:
Victor overhears Nikki leaving an important message for Paul. Later, Paul tells Nikki important information about her son. Victoria questions Victor’s intentions as they ponder their next move for Newman Enterprises.

Adam promises that his son will always know he cares about him. Chelsea is surprised to find out that Stitch is working in the hospital. He mentions that Dylan decided to stay in town. Later, Adam gets the results of Connor’s paternity tests. 

Lauren tells Avery that Michael needs her help now that Carmine is dead. Meanwhile, Paul questions Michael’s story about the night that Carmine died. Lauren and Avery show up and Avery wants to talk to Michael alone.

videos.title: Episode 10260 - Tuesday, October 8, 2013
videos.overview:
Lauren finds Fenmore and demands to know what he remembers about the night that Carmine died. Meanwhile, Paul demands the truth from Michael. Paul tells Alex that the gun was fired twice, but Michael didn’t say that in his original statement.

Abby confronts Tyler about blowing her off. He admits it’s because she told him she loves him. Tyler admits that it freaked him out because he feels the same way about her.

Courtney drops by to see Noah and brings him a sample suit from Jabot for his company tour of Newman. They share a kiss as she ties his tie for him. Meanwhile, Sharon tells Nick that she is worried about Noah working for Newman Enterprises. Nick shares her concern, but is willing to let Noah make his own choices. Later, Jack calls with an important update about Phyllis.

videos.title: Episode 10261 - Wednesday, October 9, 2013
videos.overview:
The doctor gives Jack and important update about Phyllis. Meanwhile, Sharon opens up to Nick and reveals how much she’s been struggling.

Nikki considers revealing her secret and goes to Paul for advice. Paul suggests that her son may also be looking for her. 

Stitch listens as Dylan considers his next move after he ended up kissing Avery. Later, Nikki bumps into the guys and Stitch comments that he knew their paths would cross again. 

Chelsea fills Chloe in on Adam getting confirmation that he’s Connor’s father. Chloe shares that things are changing for her and Kevin and they are going to see Delia’s play together.

videos.title: Episode 10262 - Thursday, October 10, 2013
videos.overview:
Kevin, Chloe, and Billy get Delia and her new dog Dash ready for her big performance as the Wicked Witch in the school play. Meanwhile, Victoria is forced to stay back home with Johnny when their babysitter gets sick. After the play, Kevin and Chloe congratulate Delia on her amazing performance. Kevin and Chloe head out to see a movie together while Billy takes Delia out for ice cream. 

Dylan bumps into Nikki at the coffeehouse and senses that something is troubling her. Nikki admits that she’s been stressed and Dylan questions if it’s because of him. When Nikki questions why Dylan thinks that, he admits that the Newman family probably holds him responsible for what happened between Nick and Avery.

The doctor informs Chelsea and Adam that the only option for Connor is a corneal transplant, but it has to happen before he’s six weeks old.

Victor asks Victoria to head the merger of Chancellor Industries and Newman Enterprises. Victor is pleased that Victoria is willing to consider his offer.

videos.title: Episode 10263 - Friday, October 11, 2013
videos.overview: Tragedy strikes Genoa City.

videos.title: Episode 10264 - Monday, October 14, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria shows Nikki pictures of Delia in her costume from the play. Billy calls Victoria and tells her about Delia’s accident. Victoria rushes to the hospital.

The police question Billy about what happened at the accident. Chloe rushes into the hospital after she hears about Delia. Meanwhile, Alex finds the tire marks where the car skidded then went off the road. 

Adam tells Chelsea he will do whatever he has to do to find cornea’s for Connor, including going to the black market.

videos.title: Episode 10265 - Tuesday, October 15, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe confronts Billy about leaving Delia alone in the car. Alex promises that he is going to find the person that caused the accident. When Kevin offers to help, Alex tells him that he can’t get involved. 

Jack tells Adam that now is the time to strike against Victor. Chelsea returns and tells Jack and Adam about Delia.

videos.title: Episode 10267 - Thursday, October 17, 2013
videos.overview:
Sharon admits to taking advantage of spending time with Nick and not discouraging Faith as much as she should have been. 

Adam meets with the black market organ dealer. Later, Adam bumps into Billy.

Avery heads to the Underground and has an important conversation with Nick about their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 10269 - Monday, October 21, 2013
videos.overview:
Dr. March informs Adam and Chelsea that the corneas Adam obtained for Connor aren’t viable. Meanwhile, Victoria reminds Chloe that Billy is coping with the loss of Delia as much as she is. Later, Chloe and Billy run into Chelsea in the hospital.

Avery runs into Nick in the park and asks if they can try to be friends. Later, Dylan shows Avery the legal document he just received saying his parental rights to Connor have been revoked.

Nikki comes to see Paul and wants to know if he is close to finding the hit and run driver. Paul assures her that they are working nonstop. Meanwhile, Alex looks at footage from a security camera and sees an SUV that points him to an unlikely suspect. 

Victoria tells Nick about her struggle to comfort Billy.

videos.title: Episode 10270 - Tuesday, October 22, 2013
videos.overview:
Nikki hires Avery to help her with her will. Avery is floored when Nikki reveals that she needs to add her son to her will, her son being Dylan. 

Alex continues to go over the list of potential suspects. Meanwhile, Chelsea tells Chloe that Connor needs a cornea transplant but it’s a longshot because a donor is hard to find. Later, Billy and Chloe reach an important decision. 

Dylan tells Sharon that part of him really wants to get back together with Avery but he’s not sure what his next move should be. Sharon encourages him to make things work with Avery.

Jill returns to Genoa City to see Billy.

videos.title: Episode 10271 - Wednesday, October 23, 2013
videos.overview:
Dr. Lintz tells Adam and Chelsea about Connor’s operation. Meanwhile, Victoria tries to comfort Billy and tells him that a part of Delia will now live on through Connor. 

Chloe starts going through the envelopes and pulls out Delia’s costume and wonders why the scarf is missing. Meanwhile, Jack comes to visit Billy at the restaurant. Billy says that if Jack wants to help, he can leave him alone.

Adam remembers finding Delia’s scarf and makes an important decision about what to do next.

videos.title: Episode 10272 - Thursday, October 24, 2013
videos.overview:
While at the park, Cane and Lily discuss Delia and how grateful they are for their family. Cane promises that he and Lily will keep Mattie and Charles safe.

Christine confides in Paul how upset she is over Michael going to prison for killing Carmine. Later, Lauren is shocked when Michael’s hearing takes a shocking turn.

Victor visits Adam and gives him a gift for Connor. Adam lashes out at Victor and refuses the gift. 

Jack and Jill discuss how they can help Billy. They plan a press conference and offer a reward for any information on the hit and run.

videos.title: Episode 10273 - Friday, October 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack gathers the Abbott family together to discuss how they can help Billy. Later, Traci, Kyle, Summer, Abby, and Jack are delighted when Ashley returns to offer her support. 

Adam runs into Sharon and Faith in the park. When Sharon questions what is troubling Adam, he explains the transplant that Connor received from Delia.

Nick agrees to go riding with Sharon and Faith. When Nick asks Sharon how she is doing, she tells Nick that she has a new prescription and is taking her pills. 

Against Lauren’s wishes, Fen tells Christine he was high the night that Carmine died. Lauren is horrified as Fen continues to share information about the night Carmine died. Meanwhile, Michael continues to frustrate Paul when he refuses to tell the truth about the night that Carmine died. Later, Paul surprises Christine.

videos.title: Episode 10274 - Monday, October 28, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery blasts Nikki for dragging her into her secret about being Dylan’s mother. Victor interrupts and questions why Nikki is updating her will. Later, Avery tells Nikki she would rather get disbarred than hide this secret from Dylan.

Paul explains to Christine that they have a shard of plastic from a headlight that Alex things may have come off the car that hit Delia. 

The Abbott family welcomes Ashley back to Genoa City. Billy eventually opens up to Ashley about the nightmare he’s been going through since Delia died. 

Tyler admits to Leslie that he is serious about Abby even though it wasn’t what they planned. Neil comes to see Leslie and she tells him she has an idea on how to get through to Hilary. Meanwhile, Mason tells Hilary that they should leave town. Hilary lashes out at Mason and he leaves her alone. Later, Leslie visits Hilary with important information.

videos.title: Episode 10275 - Tuesday, October 29, 2013
videos.overview:
Chloe prepares for Delia’s funeral and greets guests with Kevin outside the church. Meanwhile, Esther and Jill prepare to have everyone to the Chancellor mansion after the service. 

Chelsea tells Adam that she feels guilty that they are happy when Delia is being buried today. Chelsea wants to be at the funeral, but doesn’t want to leave Connor. Adam goes to Delia’s memorial and leaves a single rose for her. 

Reed returns to Genoa City and tries to comfort a heartbroken Billy. Billy tells Victoria and Reed to go to the service without him and he’ll meet them there. In a rare moment, Victor tells Billy that he faced today with courage and dignity, and that his father would be proud. Later, Billy finds an unexpected surprise.

videos.title: Episode 10276 - Wednesday, October 30, 2013
videos.overview:
Paul tells Christine that there isn’t any evidence that Fen killed Carmine, but he knows Michael didn’t either. Paul and Christine discuss why Michael would cover for Fen, and that it’s possible he’s covering for Lauren. 

Hilary and Neil reach a new understanding and have an important discussion about Rose. 

Fen meets Raven at the coffeehouse and she tells him shocking information about someone he knows.

videos.title: Episode 10277 - Thursday, October 31, 2013
videos.overview:
Faith and Nick visit the ranch on Halloween. Victor confides in Nick that he is worried about Nikki. Later, Victor tells Devon he wants to help him the way he believes Katherine would have wanted him too. Once Devon is gone, Victor makes a phone call telling the other person he needs to see them immediately. 

Billy and Victoria struggle through their first Halloween without Delia. 

Mason tells Devon that he wants to make up for what he did. Devon says he wouldn’t ever trust him with anything. Later, Mason plots to worm his way into Devon’s life. 

Dr. Lintz gives Chelsea and Adam an important update about Connor.

videos.title: Episode 10278 - Friday, November 1, 2013
videos.overview:
Michael reminds Kevin that he was a great stepfather to Delia. When Kevin asks Michael for advice on how to help Chloe, Michael tells him just to keep on loving her. 

Lauren struggles with Fenmore’s confession and pleads with Paul to help her free Michael. 

Dr. Lintz informs Adam and Chelsea that Connor’s transplant was a success. Later, Adam is surprised when Chelsea tells him unexpected news. 

Neil reaches out to Jack and asks if he might consider hiring her at Jabot. Meanwhile, Cane tells Hilary that he doesn’t want her anywhere near Jabot or his family and that she needs to turn down Neil’s offer and leave town.

videos.title: Episode 10279 - Monday, November 4, 2013
videos.overview: Billy tells Victoria that he is going to find the person that ran down his littler girl so the punishment will actually fit the crime. Meanwhile, Adam sets up a video camera and tapes his confession to the hit and run death of Delia.Alex and Kevin tell Chloe about the plastic they found and how it narrows down the SUV that hit Delia.Jack and Hilary have an important discussion at the Athletic Club about the plans for her future.Dylan and Chelsea discuss their relationship as he presents her with divorce papers. Chelsea makes an important decision about her future.

videos.title: Episode 10280 - Tuesday, November 5, 2013
videos.overview:
Leslie meets up with Avery and stumbles upon important information. 

Nikki and Victor question Sharon’s intentions towards Nick. Later, Sharon and Nick end up in close quarters together.

Adam watches the video of his confession, but stops it when Avery arrives. He tells her that he needs a lawyer.

videos.title: Episode 10281 - Wednesday, November 6, 2013
videos.overview:
Jill meets with Victor about Newsman-Chancellor. When Jill resists Victor’s plans, he reminds her that she has no say in the company and that this was Katherine’s plan. Later, Jill goes to see Jack. 

Noah helps Nick and Sharon out of a jam. 

Paul tells Christine that he’s determined to save the Baldwin family from Carmine’s murder. Later, Paul realizes that the crime scene photos are missing from the evidence bag.

videos.title: Episode 10282 - Thursday, November 7, 2013
videos.overview:
Victoria finds Billy on his computer again having not slept. He tells her he will sleep after he finds the person that killed his daughter. 

Chelsea wonders why Adam is suddenly anxious for her to move out. Before Adam can answer, Billy comes over to see Connor.

When Jill finds out that Jack hired Hilary at Jabot, she is furious and questions Jack’s motives. Jack tells Jill to trust him and reminds her that they need to focus on the task at hand, which is taking down Victor. Hilary suggests planting someone on the inside to get close to Victor. 

Dylan comes to the ranch and Victor tells him he won’t let him near his family. Nikki says she invited Dylan over because she is doing a charity event for Veteran’s Day. 

Abby questions who has been repeatedly calling Tyler. When Tyler reveals that his ex has been reaching out to him, Abby jumps to conclusions and worries that Tyler may not be as invested in their relationship as she thought. Later, Tyler tells Abby that she is the only woman for him.

videos.title: Episode 10283 - Friday, November 8, 2013
videos.overview: When Chelsea asks Adam if he has found anything out about Delia’s hit and run, Adam says that they need to wait for a solid lead. Meanwhile, Kevin grows frustrated with how slow the progress in the case is going. Alex assures Kevin that they are doing everything they can and they will catch the driver who ran down Delia. Alex bumps into Adam at the GCAC and they have a heated discussion about the accident. Later, Chloe tells Kevin that she can’t handle being anything more friends right now.When Summer bumps into Courtney and Noah, Courtney gets uncomfortable when they start talking about Fen and his taking drugs. Summer goes to see Fen in prison and he struggles to remember what happened the night that Carmine died. Later, Courtney sends Zach a text telling him that she needs to see him as soon as possible.Alex and Adam have a heated encounter.

videos.title: Episode 10284 - Monday, November 11, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam feels guilty when Chelsea says they owe Billy and Chloe for donating Delia’s corneas. Later, Victoria pays Adam a surprise visit. Meanwhile, Billy joins a chat room for other people that have lost children. Billy leaves in frustration and prepares to take action. 

Devon tells Jack and Jill that he doesn’t want to be a spy and doesn’t want to work with Hilary.

When Victor asks Nikki why she has taken on doing an event for Veteran’s Day, Nikki tells him that they have taken the military for granted and she wants to help, especially after meeting Stitch and knowing that he was able to finish medical school because of the Army. Friends and family gather at The Underground as several veterans arrive for the celebration. Meanwhile, Avery encourages Dylan to attend the event.

videos.title: Episode 10285 - Tuesday, November 12, 2013
videos.overview:
Victor gets upset when Dylan arrives at the Veteran’s Day event. Paul realizes that Nikki is trying to reach out to Dylan with this event. Nick tells Avery that no matter what happened between them, Dylan deserves to be at the event.

Fen tells Summer that he remembers pulling the trigger, but everything else is hazy. Later, he tells Summer shocking news about Courtney. 

At the Underground, Devon opens up a bar tab, and Mason steals his credit card. 

Jill visits Billy and tells him that she will take care of things at the restaurant for him. When Victoria gets home, Billy admits to her that he needs help.

Paul tells Lauren that they found a napkin in the alley near Carmine’s body and it had her DNA on it. Lauren suggests that Carmine took the napkin as a memento. Paul says she could be right, but he knows that Michael didn’t kill Carmine. 

Avery admits to Dylan that she never realized how deeply she could love someone or what real terror felt like until he was gone and she was alone. Dylan surprises Avery with a kiss.

videos.title: Episode 10286 - Wednesday, November 13, 2013
videos.overview:
Abby and Traci share the good news with Jack and Kyle that Billy has agreed to go to grief counseling. Abby is touched when the family wishes her a happy birthday. Meanwhile, Noah teases Tyler about being in love with Abby. Later, Victor makes a surprising offer to Abby. 

Michael tells the Warden that he is willing to get information out of other prisoners for unsolved crimes in exchange for a reduced sentence for Fen. Christine comes into the meeting and tells the Warden that the prisoner they think can help with unsolved crimes is Womack. 

Summer questions Courtney about being involved with drugs and tells her what Fen said. Noah arrives as things get tense between Summer and Courtney. 

Tyler sets up a romantic picnic in the park for Abby. When he looks down at his phone, he notices six missed calls from Mariah.

videos.title: Episode 10287 - Thursday, November 14, 2013
videos.overview:
Victor accuses Sharon of using Faith to get Nick back and tells her that she has no business being a parent. Adam interrupts and challenges Victor’s history as a parent. 

Tyler calls Mariah and tells her that he’s not interested in getting back together. Later, Tyler surprises Abby with her birthday present. 

Neil comes home to find Leslie having set up a romantic night for the two of them. They discuss being able to move on now that Hilary has forgiven him. Meanwhile, Hilary goes to the Abbott mansion to have Jack sign some documents. Jack introduces Hilary to Kyle who is impressed with her resume. Later, Jack finds Hilary and Kyle discussing people who could be a mole at Newman-Chancellor. Victor is taken aback when Kyle asks him for a job.

videos.title: Episode 10288 - Friday, November 15, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy and Victoria go to a meeting for a bereavement group and meet a woman named Kelly whose son died in an accident. Kelly admits that she and her husband split up after their son died. 

Avery tells Leslie that Dylan kissed her. While Leslie is happy for her friend, Avery worries that it could lead to disaster since she is keeping the secret about Nikki being Dylan’s mother. Meanwhile, Dylan bumps into Chelsea and Connor in the park. Chelsea tells Dylan that she has decided to continue living with Adam. When Chelsea goes home with Connor and asks Adam if he has heard anything about the hit and run, Adam explodes and says that asking about it every five seconds doesn’t help. Later, Adam apologizes and tells Chelsea that he just wishes he had answers. 

Nick tells Sharon that Dylan showed up with Avery to the Veteran’s Day event. When Sharon tells Nick about Victor accusing her of locking them in the freezer together and that Adam came to her defense, Nick tells her not to let Adam back into her life. When Nick and Sharon take Faith to Crimson Lights, they bump into Dylan and Faith tells him that she wants a new dollhouse. Later, Dylan tells Avery that he’s thinking about surprising Faith with the dollhouse.

videos.title: Episode 10289 - Monday, November 18, 2013
videos.overview:
Nikki tells Paul that she is ready for Dylan to know she is his mother, but first she needs to tell the rest of her family. When Nikki worries how Victor will react, Paul tries to reassure her that everyone will ultimately support her and appreciate that she told the truth. Meanwhile, Nick and Dylan have a heated argument. 

Billy and Adam continue to post on the grief website. 

Paul updates Kevin saying they are bringing in a profiler to help with the hit and run case. Later, Kevin asks for Adam’s help in getting Chloe to stop spending so much time around Connor.

videos.title: Episode 10290 - Tuesday, November 19, 2013
videos.overview:
Christine tries to get Paul to take a break from Carmine’s murder investigation, but he refuses. Later, Paul gets an idea that might get Michael out of prison. Fen informs Michael that he has found a way to fix things. Michael is stunned to find out that Fen made a deal with the Warden in order to get him out of jail.

Victor finds out that Kyle hasn’t told Jack that he wants to work for Newman-Chancellor. Kyle sees no point in telling his father unless Victor had a real offer for him. 

Lily and Cane discuss their future and bump into Roxy who is sporting a new bracelet. Roxy admits that Devon has been spoiling her lately. Later, Devon questions what Roxy has been up to and asks where their relationship is going when she tries to put a deposit down on a condo for them.

videos.title: Episode 10291 - Wednesday, November 20, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam tells Chelsea that Kevin thinks it hurts Chloe to be around Connor. Later, Chloe comes over and says that she likes being around Connor because it keeps her close to Delia. Later, Adam runs into Billy at On the Blvd and meets Kelly. 

Billy spots a box with a dress of Delia’s in it and asks Victoria what she is doing with his daughter’s things. Victoria explains that Chloe asked for some of Delia’s belongings. 

Devon tries to make things up to Roxy and offers to buy the condo. Cane and Lily enjoy fantasizing about their future.

videos.title: Episode 10292 - Thursday, November 21, 2013
videos.overview: Sharon apologizes to Dylan for the misunderstanding about Faith’s dollhouse and because Nick lashed out at him. Later, Dylan makes plans for him and Avery to have dinner at the club, while Nick tells Sharon that Nikki has planned a family dinner at the club. Nick and Dylan both remain unaware that their dinner planers are on a collision course.Noah is surprised to find out that Victor hired Kyle. Late, Nick warns Noah again of what working for Victor can cost him.Abby encourages Jack to ask Summer to spend Thanksgiving with the Abbott’s. Later, Summer suggests that she and Jack go see Phyllis for Thanksgiving.Mason flirts with the barista at Crimson Lights while he slyly uses Devon’s credit card. Later, Devon bumps into Mason and questions if he’s been following him. When Mason plays it cool, Devon offers to buy Mason a drink and tells him they should get something stronger than coffee.

videos.title: Episode 10293 - Friday, November 22, 2013
videos.overview: When Nick questions Nikki about the dinner and ask if she’s feeling alright, Nikki assures him that she is fine. The Newman family gathers at the club for dinner as Nikki prepares to tell her family her news about Dylan. Nikki is interrupted by Dylan and Avery’s arrival. When Nick goes over to confront Dylan, Avery tries unsuccessfully to try and stop them from fighting.Michael worries when a guard refers to Fen as Mouse. Paul visits Michael in prison with good news. When Michael hopes that Paul is having Fen moved to a safer part of the prison, Paul says that Fen isn’t being moved, but there is a good chance they can get a reversal on Michael’s conviction. Michael is worried that if he gets out then Fen won’t be protected.Victor’s P.I. tells him that he should have a list of cars that match the license plate soon. Later, Victoria asks Adam if he has found anything out from his contacts about Delia’s hit and run. Adam tells her that he hasn’t and that he wishes people would stop hounding him.

videos.title: Episode 10294 - Monday, November 25, 2013
videos.overview: Nikki reveals her shocking secret to the Newman family. When Dylan questions Nikki’s story, she reveals all of the details about how he was born. Later, Dylan is stunned when he learns that Avery already knew Nikki’s secret.Neil invites Leslie to spend Thanksgiving together.Noah admits to Sharon that he is upset that Victor hired Kyle. Sharon encourages him not to be upset and that if he believes in himself, Victor will too. Later, Noah and Courtney enjoy an evening of romance.Billy and Kelly run into each other outside the support group meeting.

videos.title: Episode 10295 - Tuesday, November 26, 2013
videos.overview: Nick tells Sharon about Dylan being Nikki’s son.  Sharon urges Nick to find it in his heart to give his mother a break.  Meanwhile, Nikki explains to Victor that she wasn’t just hiding her secret from him, she was hiding it from herself. Chelsea tells Adam that she is starting to see in him the man that she remembers he can be.  Adam warns Chelsea not to put him on a pedestal. Christine tells Michael that the judge ruled to reopen the case. Jill celebrates Thanksgiving with Kevin, Chloe and Esther.  Everyone reminisces about Katherine.  Later, Lauren stops by to join them for dinner.

videos.title: Episode 10296 - Wednesday, November 27, 2013
videos.overview: Nick and Sharon enjoy celebrating Thanksgiving with Faith and Noah. Ashley surprises everyone at the Abbott mansion for Thanksgiving.  Meanwhile, Abby is puzzled by Tyler’s repeated phone calls from Mariah. Leslie takes in the site of family at Neil’s and considers her future. When Dylan tells Nikki that he wants proof that he’s her son, she agrees to a DNA test.  Later, Victoria has an important discussion with Dylan.

videos.title: Episode 10297 - Monday, December 2, 2013
videos.overview:
After Ashley sprains her ankle during Thanksgiving, Abby takes her to the hospital to get it looked at. Abby is delighted to find that Stitch is the doctor on call and tries to play matchmaker for her mother. When Stitch leaves the room, Ashley points out that he is married. Later, Abby opens up about her relationship with Tyler and how she is worried about his ex, Mariah. 

Noah and Kyle pitch ideas to Victor about growing the youth demographics for Newman-Chancellor. Later, Jill and Jack question Kyle’s involvement with Victor.

Victoria tells Billy about Dylan and suggests that he might be able to help him understand what it’s like to deal with the Newman’s. Billy tells Victoria that he’d rather not get in the middle of her family drama. As he heads out to a grief meeting, Victoria prepares to go with him, but he tells her he is more comfortable going alone. Later, Billy runs into Kelly outside of the meeting and they agree to go out for coffee.

videos.title: Episode 10298 - Tuesday, December 3, 2013
videos.overview: Nick tells Summer about Dylan being a new part of their family. Nick is struck by Summer’s point of view on the awkward situation given her recent discovery about her paternity. Sharon overhears their conversation and ponders the secret she’s keeping from Nick and Summer. Later, Sharon bumps into Dylan and offers to listen if he wants someone to talk with. Lauren and Michael worry that even though Fen’s drug sentence is almost up, Paul could still figure out that he killed Carmine. Michael wants to find out exactly what Paul knows. Billy shares with Kelly the story of Delia meeting Johnny for the first time. He likes talking with her and can really open up, something he can’t do with his own wife and family. Chloe comes in and Billy introduces her to Kelly and explains how they met at a support group. Billy tells Kelly about when Delia met Johnny for the first time. Chloe notices Billy and he introduces her to Kelly and mentions that they met in a support group. Meanwhile, Chelsea and Adam begin to reconnect and she tells him that she isn’t in a hurry to move out.

videos.title: Episode 10299 - Wednesday, December 4, 2013
videos.overview: When Neil offers Sharon a job at Jabot as a mentor to the young models, Sharon gladly accepts.  When Nick learns about Sharon’s new gig, he tells her he is happy that Summer will have such a positive influence in her life.Meanwhile, Womack offers Fen drugs in prison.  When some prisoners try and go after Fen, Womack steps up and tells them to leave Fen alone.  When Fen questions his intentions, Womack says that now Fen owes him one.  Meanwhile, Michael is shocked to learn that some of the photos from the crime scene are missing. Neil tells Lily and Cane that he is going to ask Leslie to move in with him.Nick tells Dylan that he wants them to settle their differences without throwing punches.  Dylan wants to put the conversation on hold until the DNA test comes back.  Later, Avery  tries to get Dylan to open up to her.

videos.title: Episode 10300 - Thursday, December 5, 2013
videos.overview:
When Victor overhears Nikki leaving Paul a message, he realizes that they were working together to find Nikki’s son. Victor confronts Nikki about trusting another man with something so important.

Alex warns Billy that he can’t go around threatening people, even on the internet. Alex goes to look at Billy’s computer and finds that he has been watching a video of Delia. Billy says that this is what he does every day because it’s all he has left, so how can Alex tell him that he can’t want the same fate for the person that killed his daughter.

Tyler apologizes to Lily for getting in the middle of her marriage. Meanwhile, Noah confides in Abby and says that he doesn’t have a problem being challenged by Victor and that working with Kyle is the real issue. Abby demands that Kyle and Noah shake hands and agree to not continue Victor and Jack’s feud. 

Victor overhears Chelsea mentioning a fashion show in Milan while meeting with a buyer. When Victor asks if Chelsea thinks she can take his grandson out of the country, Chelsea stands up to Victor telling him he has no say in Connor’s life.

videos.title: Episode 10301 - Friday, December 6, 2013
videos.overview:
Avery and Nick have a tense discussion about Dylan being a part of the Newman family. Avery questions if Dylan and Nick would have a shot at treating each other like family if she wasn’t in the middle. Dylan opens up to Stitch about his biological father and how he was the leader of a cult. 

Chelsea thanks Adam for standing up for her and appreciates that the complications Victor used to bring to their relationship don’t exist anymore. Things heat up as they passionately kiss. Later, Chelsea tells Adam that they’re in a good place now and she doesn’t want to mess anything up and that their main focus has to be on Connor. 

Cane figures out that Jill is still planning on going after Victor. Jill insists that she is only going after what is rightfully hers and what Katherine must have truly wanted for her all along. Later, Jill says that she intends to sell Katherine’s music box. 

Paul assures Kevin that they are doing all they can to find who ran down Delia.

When Victor asks Nikki if Paul was with her when she went to Chicago, Nikki admits that he had been helping her find her son. Nikki admits to Victor that she was worried that he would try and stop her from finding her son.

videos.title: Episode 10302 - Monday, December 9, 2013
videos.overview:
Nikki gets confirmation that Dylan is her son. When Paul tries to look on the positive side, Nikki says Dylan wants nothing to do with her. Paul tells Christine about Nikki being Dylan’s mother and how he helped her track him down. Christine is upset that he kept this from her, but Paul assures her that nothing is going on between him and Nikki. 

Courtney buys drugs from Raven in the park. Later, Courtney opens up to Summer and says that Zach is a family member that she’s embarrassed of. Noah arrives and asks the girls what they’re talking about. Later, Summer tells Dylan that she knows what he’s going through.

Michael and Lauren try to celebrate their anniversary in the midst of worrying about Fen being in prison. Lauren gets another anonymous phone call. Later, Christine calls and tells Michael and Lauren that Fen will be released soon.

videos.title: Episode 10303 - Tuesday, December 10, 2013
videos.overview: Kelly gives Billy a book of inspirational quotes and asks how Johnny’s preschool interview went. Victoria tells Billy that she is glad he has someone like Kelly to help him even though she is hurt that she can’t be that person.When Jack urges Devon to figure out what it is that he really wants to do, Devon admits that he doesn’t know what he wants. Jack offers him a reprieve by telling him to take a leave of absence from Jabot.Cane and Lily have an important meeting at the hospital.Abby is upset with Tyler because she thinks that he took her to Los Angeles to relive his past with Mariah. Their fight escalates and both admit that they are scared of losing each other.

videos.title: Episode 10304 - Wednesday, December 11, 2013
videos.overview: Nick tells Nikki that he understands why she kept her secret and admits that he will have to find a way to deal with Dylan being her son.  Victoria tells Victor that if Dylan isn’t welcome in the family then she isn’t going to be a part of it either.  Later, Avery gives Dylan information that she found on Ian Ward. Leslie meets up with Neil and asks him what he’s been up to.  Neil slyly admits that he won’t tell her anything more and that she’ll have to wait until Christmas.  Neil intends to change her view on the holidays and make this one to remember. Hilary finds a bottle of pills in Jack’s desk.

videos.title: Episode 10305 - Thursday, December 12, 2013
videos.overview: Sharon and Chloe prep a shoot with Summer and another model, Esmerelda.  Nick arrives and takes in the sight of how grown up Summer is.  Nick and Sharon console Chloe and try to offer support from their own experience with losing Cassie. Adam surprises Chelsea with a Christmas tree and tells her that he will make up for last year and make sure Connor’s first Christmas is great.   Paul tells Christine that it’s only a matter of time before one of the Baldwin’s goes to prison for killing Carmine.  Paul tells Christine that whoever shot Carmine probably did it in self-defense, but there is no way of knowing for sure.  Meanwhile, Fen tells Michael and Lauren that he needs to disappear.  Michael asks Fen to promise him that he will stay in Genoa City.  Later, Lauren tells Michael that they should consider going on the run since Fen’s sobriety chip is missing and if it turns up it could lead the police to think that he was the person who killed Carmine.

videos.title: Episode 10307 - Monday, December 16, 2013
videos.overview:
Stitch and Victoria recall meeting each other at the Veteran’s Day event. He expresses his condolences over Delia and knows it must be really hard this time of year. Meanwhile, Billy and Kelly go to the Underground for a drink. Billy tells Kelly that he wants to connect with Victoria, but he just can’t. Mason makes travel plans with Devon’s credit card. Meanwhile, Hilary thanks Devon for defending her with Lily. 

Adam and Chelsea make love. 

Dylan tells Avery that he understands now why Nikki gave him up after reading the file on Ian Ward. 

When Sharon prepares to open up to Nick, Noah arrives with a Christmas tree. Sharon, Nick, Noah and Faith decorate the tree together.

videos.title: Episode 10308 - Tuesday, December 17, 2013
videos.overview: Jill vents her frustration to Esther about the music box. Esther puts the pieces together about who it is from.Jack warns Kyle not to underestimate Victor and tells him to look into Bonaventure Industries.Neil tells Avery to try to keep Leslie’s schedule clear because he has a Christmas surprise for her. Avery figures out that Neil plans on proposing to Leslie! Meanwhile, Lauren blames Leslie for defending Carmine and having the drug dealing charges dropped. Paul calls Michael and asks him to collect his personal effects from the night he was arrested. Paul tells Christine that he finally found the first piece of evidence that could lead them to Carmine’s real killer. Later, Fen withdraws his confession.Noah brings a Christmas tree to Sharon’s and they decorate it with Nick and Faith. Later, Noah meets up with Courtney and she receives another text from Zach.

videos.title: Episode 10309 - Wednesday, December 18, 2013
videos.overview: Chloe is shocked to learn that Chelsea slept with Adam. When Adam arrives, Chloe warns him to be good to Chelsea and Connor. Meanwhile, Billy and Victoria go through the mail and receive a notification that a charity has been set up in Delia’s honor. Victoria questions why someone would do this for Delia and not want anyone to know.Alex tells Kevin that they have a lead on Delia’s hit and run. Chloe rushes into the station wanting to see the person that killed Delia. Chloe is disappointed when she learns that the evidence doesn’t match up and they caught the wrong guy.Cane and Lily get the test results back from her MRI.Adam asks if Kelly kept her promise to keep his involvement in Delia’s foundation quiet.

videos.title: Episode 10310 - Thursday, December 19, 2013
videos.overview:
Friends and family gather at The Underground to celebrate Summer’s birthday. Victor is troubled by Sharon’s presence as he watches Nicholas and her work together. Victor warns Nick to prevent Sharon from finding a way back into his life, or else he will. Abby tells everyone to hide when she hears Summer coming in with Noah. When Summer arrives, everyone jumps out and yells surprise. Summer opens up to Nick and admits that this birthday is hard because it reminds her of how everything was different for them a year ago. 

Paul obtains the suit that Fen was wearing the night that Carmine died. Paul tells Christine that if there are traces of Carmine’s blood on it and gun powder, then it puts Fen at the murder scene. 

Neil is shocked that Devon is being charged with trashing a hotel room in Las Vegas. Devon insists that he was never in Vegas and claims that someone has stolen his identity. 

Kyle finds the Bonaventure file in Victor’s office and starts photographing the pages, when Noah walks in and catches him.

videos.title: Episode 10311 - Friday, December 20, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack leaves a message for Kyle asking him what he has found out about Bonaventure. Billy is surprised that Jack is using Kyle in his fight against Victor. Jack explains that it was Kyle’s idea and he needed someone he could trust. 

When Noah asks what Kyle is doing in Victor’s office, Kyle tries to play it off and says he was just leaving a note for Victor. Victor interrupts their argument and asks them to research all the companies that Newman-Chancellor owns and see which are worth keeping. 

Faith tells Nick and Sharon that they should all celebrate Christmas together. 

Billy surprises Victoria with a tiny Christmas tree. She tells him it’s perfect and wraps her arms around him. They decorate the tree and put Delia’s ornament on top. She pulls him into her arms and promises that they will get through this.

videos.title: Episode 10312 - Monday, December 23, 2013
videos.overview:
Nick asks Avery what she plans to do for the holidays. Things get tense when she alludes to the fact that she and Dylan don’t have any plans. 

Victor and Nikki have a heated discussion about the changes she’s made to her will. Dylan arrives to ask Nikki if she knows anything about his father, Ian Ward. Nikki says that she hasn’t seen him since before Dylan was born and is probably dead. 

Someone sneaks into Abby and Tyler’s hotel room in Los Angeles!

Paul questions Summer about Fen and warns her that he could be an accessory to murder. Fen rushes into the police station after receiving an urgent message from Summer.

videos.title: Episode 10313 - Tuesday, December 24, 2013
videos.overview:
Faith bursts into the room as Nick and Sharon are trying to put together her doll house. Sharon explains that Santa had to drop her doll house off early. Sharon and Nick are relieved when Faith accepts their story that they are helping the elves out this year by building her doll house.

Abby is shocked when she discovers that the bed has been messed up and questions Tyler when she sees the mystery woman running out of their hotel room. Abby tells Tyler that she’s not interested in his games.

Jack is spending Christmas alone this year and Hilary sympathizes having done that a lot herself. After she goes, John appears to Jack. 

Leslie struggles with the idea of the big family Christmas as she and Neil have dinner with his family. 

Michael asks Christine to make Fen’s arraignment happen as soon as possible so he won’t have to spend Christmas in jail.

videos.title: Episode 10314 - Wednesday, December 25, 2013
videos.overview:
Adam and Chelsea celebrate Connor’s first Christmas. They are interrupted by Chloe who is there with presents for Connor and fabric samples for Chelsea. When Chloe leaves, Chelsea tells Adam that she wants her to be Connor’s godmother. Meanwhile, Victor gives Victoria shares of Newman-Chancellor for her to give to Johnny. She is touched by his gesture and points out that he loves Johnny as family even though he is not biologically his grandson. Victor tells her that he sees what she is trying to do and he doesn’t plan on ever accepting Dylan as a part of their family. 

Leslie works on Christmas to help get the charges against Devon dropped. Alex tells her to go home and enjoy the day. Later, Neil asks why Leslie has been avoiding him. 

Jack does his best to try and distract Billy by giving him gifts for ice fishing. Billy confides in Jack that he saw Delia by the tree. 

A plumbing problem at the Coffee House causes Dylan to be stuck there until someone shows up to fix it. Avery is determined to not let this ruin their Christmas plans and she brings Christmas dinner to him.

videos.title: Episode 10315 - Thursday, December 26, 2013
videos.overview:
Billy bumps into Adam and learns that he has reunited with Chelsea. Billy declares that anything is possible if Chelsea would forgive Adam for all he has done. 

Alex tells Gloria that Kevin can’t give her any information about Delia’s investigation or Fen’s case. Gloria demands answers and a frustrated Alex leaves. Later, Gloria questions how Chloe has been coping during the holidays without Delia. Gloria watches happily as Kevin and Chloe share good memories of times with Delia. 

Jill discovers an unwrapped present under the Christmas tree and is shocked to find Katherine’s music box. 

Courtney grows uncomfortable when Noah says that he wants to meet her family. Courtney starts to tell Noah about her family but is interrupted by a text that she has to deal with. Noah explains that he heard about Zach from Summer. Courtney assures Noah that there is nobody that matters to her more than him.

videos.title: Episode 10316 - Friday, December 27, 2013
videos.overview:
Hilary brings Jill the Bonaventure file for her to look over. Devon tells Jill and Hilary about the identity theft, and Jill warns him to be careful with whom he trusts. Devon runs into Mason on his way to the gym and they have a heated argument when Devon reveals that he knows that Mason was behind the scam in Las Vegas.

Kyle gives his findings of Bonaventure to Victor. Victor tells Kyle that he doesn’t want any weak links in his businesses. Meanwhile, Adam tells Jack that he is bowing out of the plan against Victor and that he wants to focus on his life with Chelsea and his son.

Billy finds Kelly crying in the park. Meanwhile, Victoria returns to her home to look for Billy after their flights to DC get cancelled.

videos.title: Episode 10317 - Monday, December 30, 2013
videos.overview:
Jack tells Jill that he thinks it would be good if Billy was in charge of the foundation that was set up in Delia’s name. Jill thinks it’s a great idea and calls the charity to find out who she should speak with about Delia’s foundation.

When Dylan questions Nikki about his biological father, Nikki tells him that she hopes he isn’t planning to go look for him. Dylan says that he has questions only Ian can answer. Before she leaves, Nikki asks Dylan to be careful.

Adam tells Chelsea that since her divorce is final, there’s no reason they can’t get married. Chelsea is shocked by Adam’s unexpected declaration as they slowly start to see how serious they both are about the idea. Adam tries to play it cool but Chelsea senses that he's serious. 

Billy’s evening takes a shocking turn!

videos.title: Episode 10318 - Tuesday, December 31, 2013
videos.overview:
Traci and Ashley surprise Jack on New Year’s Eve and tell him that he needs to start living his life again. Later, Ashley asks Victor to try and make peace with Jack. Victor taunts Jack over what happened last New Year’s Eve and how Adam helped him. Victor calls Adam and says he needs to speak with him immediately.

Sharon meets Stitch for the first time at the coffee house. Later, Stitch bumps into Kelly and they are shocked to see each other!

Billy returns and Victoria asks if he got her messages, but he says that his phone was off. Victoria apologizes and says that she wants things to go back to normal for them.

videos.title: Episode 10319 - Thursday, January 2, 2014
videos.overview:
