Nick and Sharon discuss the impromptu kiss they shared on New Year’s Eve. Summer stops by and picks up on something going on between them. Later, Summer thanks Nick for the way that he raised her and tells him she appreciates the good influence he’s had on her life. Meanwhile at Crimson Lights, Courtney and Noah enjoy an afternoon together. When Courtney goes to get a drink, her phone rings and Noah goes to grab it and is shocked to find a bag of pills in her bag. 

An unexpected connection is revealed!

Michael finds a box outside his door with no card or name on it. He opens the box to reveal a cake that says Forget Me Not. When Michael wonders who would have sent something like this, Lauren blurts out that it must have been Carmine. Fen arrives and tells his parents that he thinks that Womack may have sent the cake.

videos.title: Episode 10320 - Friday, January 3, 2014
videos.overview:
Adam tells Victor that he is meeting with Avery to make sure that Victor never has any legal rights to Connor. Victor tells Adam that he will regret turning his back on him. Victor meets with his P.I. who gives him a file with all the information he asked for on the hit and run. 

Victoria runs into Stitch while picking up a treat for Johnny at Crimson Lights. Later, Kelly and Victoria have a tense encounter. 

A possible witness to Delia’s hit and run is brought into the police station interrogation room. Alex leaves the door open so Kevin can listen. Meanwhile, Chelsea confronts Adam about his question about impromptu proposal.

videos.title: Episode 10321 - Monday, January 6, 2014
videos.overview: Victor asks Paul what kind of punishment the hit and run driver faces. Later, Victor takes matters into his own hands. Jill tells Kevin about her frustrations with Katherine’s music box. Jill gets a call from an antique dealer who believes that the music box belonged to someone famous. Jill grabs the box and intends to get to the bottom of the mystery but when she heads out she is apprehended and chloroformed by someone! Billy and Victoria prepare to host Kelly for dinner when Stitch stops by and tells Victoria that he found her phone at Crimson Lights. Billy ends up inviting Stitch to stay for dinner as well. Billy and Stitch make small talk as Kelly arrives and is shocked to see Stitch there. Adam asks Chelsea to marry him and she says yes again. Adam wants to get married right away. Chelsea wants to wait and she wants to know if there’s anything that he hasn’t told her.

videos.title: Episode 10322 - Tuesday, January 7, 2014
videos.overview:
The mysterious person brings Jill to a motel room where she wakes up handcuffed to a bed and demands to know who kidnapped her. Meanwhile, the kidnapper takes Jill’s phone and sends a text to Esther saying that Jill has gone out of town and doesn’t know when she will be back. 

As Chloe fusses over Connor, Neil gives Chelsea the good news that orders are pouring in for her line. Chloe realizes that Chelsea said yes to Adam’s proposal. When Chloe says she wants what’s best for Chelsea and Connor, Chelsea tells her that Adam is what is best for them. Meanwhile, Victor reveals to Adam that a witness saw the accident and that the car involved was an SUV identical to Adam’s. 

Lily and Cane receive her test results and plan for their future. 

Leslie tells Devon that he has a solid case for theft and fraud.

videos.title: Episode 10323 - Wednesday, January 8, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki bumps into Avery and learns that Dylan went to try and find Ian Ward. Nikki tells Avery that she must call Dylan and tell him to stop his search given how manipulative Ian can be. Meanwhile, Dylan meets a woman named Willa who reveals that she was Ian’s wife. When Dylan pressures Willa for information, she says that she doesn’t want to talk about it anymore.

At the GCAC, Hilary complains to the assistant manager that the showerhead in her bathroom broke and caused a flood. When she asks to speak with the owner, she is shocked to find out who it is!

Noah confronts Courtney about the pills he found. Courtney explains that they are Zach’s and he is trying to get clean. 

Nick and Sharon discuss Cassie’s birthday. Later, Sharon comes home and sees Cassie and realizes that she won’t leave her alone until she tells Nick the truth about Summer.

videos.title: Episode 10324 - Thursday, January 9, 2014
videos.overview:
Jack and Hilary plan to meet with Jill and are surprised when they get a cryptic text from her saying that she had to suddenly head out of town. A photographer takes a photo of Jack and Hilary and she worries that people might think that she is trying to go after Jack like she did with Cane. 

Sharon tells Noah that she worries about letting him and Nick down. Sharon tells Noah that sometimes she finds comfort in talking to Cassie. Meanwhile, Nick tells Victor that he recently visited Cassie’s grave. 

When Chloe tells Chelsea that she and Kevin broke up, Chelsea says that she has hope that they’ll find their way back to each other. Meanwhile, Kevin and Alex are both disappointed when the list of SUVs with a license plate starting with the letter "G” comes up empty. Alex realizes that the witness they’ve been talking to must have given them a false lead in order to strike a deal. 

Adam meets with Avery to sign the papers appointing Jack to be Connor’s legal guardian in the event anything ever happened to him or Chelsea. Avery questions why Adam thinks that he might not be around for Connor.

videos.title: Episode 10325 - Friday, January 10, 2014
videos.overview:
Friends and family gather at the church for Connor’s naming ceremony. Chelsea is shocked when Victor arrives and Adam decides to let him stay. 

Billy comes home and finds Victoria on the phone with Kelly. Billy grows uncomfortable as Victoria explains that Kelly called to apologize for leaving dinner abruptly. Later, Billy tells Adam that he knows he set up the foundation in Delia’s name. 

Kevin and Alex are both disappointed when the list of SUVs with a license plate starting with the letter "G” is empty. It seems that the witness, George, gave them bad information. Alex still thinks that George is lying in order to make a deal.

Noah apologizes to Courtney for how he acted and for pushing her about her family. Later, Courtney shows up to see "Zach” and tells him she broke up with Noah.

videos.title: Episode 10326 - Monday, January 13, 2014
videos.overview:
Jack tells Nikki that Adam wouldn’t let Victor near Connor unless Victor had something over him. Nikki questions why Adam let Victor stay at Connor’s blessing when he doesn’t want him to be a part of his life.

Dylan tells Avery that he met Ian Ward’s ex-wife and that Ian has relocated to Indiana. When Dylan tells Avery that she shouldn’t come to Indiana, Avery says that she isn’t scared and that couples support each other. When Dylan is unsure how to address their relationship status, Avery is forced to ask if they are even a couple. 

Abby and Tyler begin their search for a home and discuss the reality of what living together will be like. 

Billy tells Jack that Adam is the anonymous donor who set up Delia’s foundation. When Jack says to give Adam a little credit, Billy mentions that he heard Adam use the phrase "karmic scales” and that someone in the chat room he’s been frequenting used the same phrase.

videos.title: Episode 10327 - Tuesday, January 14, 2014
videos.overview:
Stitch visits with Dylan and asks about his search for Ian. When Nikki arrives, Stitch encourages Dylan to open up to her. Nikki asks Dylan not to follow up on the lead he found on Ian being in Indiana. 

Michael asks Paul to investigate who sent him the anonymous cake. Paul thinks Michael is being paranoid but agrees to send a patrol car by a couple of times a day. Paul reminds Michael that the best thing he can do for his family is to work on Fen’s defense. Meanwhile, Lauren meets with Neil to discuss the unveiling of Chelsea’s line at Fenmore’s. Neil thinks that they should wait until things are more settled in Lauren’s personal life.

Summer visits Fen and tries to make amends after turning him in during Christmas. Meanwhile, Michael tells Womack to stay away from Fen or he will be sorry. Womack offers to leave Fen alone if Michael can give him the name of the guy that tuned states evidence against him. Later, Summer rushes in late for a photo shoot. Esmeralda gives Summer three energy pills and tells her when she is feeling tired, she should take one.

videos.title: Episode 10328 - Wednesday, January 15, 2014
videos.overview:
Adam shows Chelsea the engagement ring he bought for her. Chelsea is caught off guard when Adam suggests they finish what they started and move to Paris. Jack interrupts them and asks Adam why he didn’t throw Victor out of the church when he showed up to Connor’s naming ceremony. Jack knows Victor has something on him, but Adam refuses to tell him what it is. When Jack leaves, Adam watches his recorded confession until he hears Connor cry. Without thinking, he puts the camcorder down and heads upstairs.

Kevin explains to Paul his theory about the license plates from the driver who hit Delia. Later, Michael and Paul discuss the night that Carmine died in the alley. 

Jack updates Sharon on Phyllis’ condition. Summer admits to Esmeralda that she took all three energy pills. Sharon arrives at the shoot and can’t find Summer anywhere. Summer is trying to catch her breath in the stairwell and calls Fen. He angrily answers the phone, but grows concerned when she can barely talk. Fen heads out the door with his ankle monitor on.

videos.title: Episode 10329 - Thursday, January 16, 2014
videos.overview:
Jack, Kyle and Hilary question why Bonaventure is suddenly turning a profit. Jack is stunned to find out that Bonaventure is selling an unapproved drug over the internet that gives you energy and helps with weight loss. Meanwhile, Sharon is horrified to find Summer laying at the bottom of the stairwell outside the photo shoot. Sharon rushes to help Summer and yells to Esmeralda to call 911. 

Kelly brings Billy the paperwork that will put Billy in charge of Delia’s foundation. Billy makes it clear to Kelly that she should not come to his house anymore. Meanwhile, Adam stops Chelsea before she plays back his confession on his camcorder. 

Noah catches Courtney buying drugs off of Raven.

videos.title: Episode 10330 - Friday, January 17, 2014
videos.overview:
Billy questions why Chelsea and Adam are moving to Paris all of a sudden. Adam plays it cool and tells Billy that the foundation is in capable hands and he is ready for a fresh start with Chelsea. Billy tells Adam that he has definitely balanced the karmic scales. Chelsea returns and gives Adam a list of everything they need to do before they leave town and at the bottom of the list Adam sees, "Get Married”. 

Kelly explains to Victoria that she and Billy aren’t friends the way she thinks they are. 

When Kevin asks Chloe to give him a chance to help her, Chloe is adamant that it will never happen because he can’t bring Delia back. Kevin starts to tell Chloe that they have a lead in the case when Chelsea interrupts and shares that she is moving to Paris with Adam. 

Lily gets a call from Nikki saying that they are hosting a fundraiser for the Delia Project. 

Jack rushes to the hospital and Sharon explains what happened and Jack wants to know why Sharon called Nick and not him. Stitch updates everyone on Summer’s condition.

videos.title: Episode 10331 - Monday, January 20, 2014
videos.overview:
Over dinner with Victor, Noah admits that Sharon told him that she used to see Cassie’s ghost. Noah asks Victor to please leave Sharon alone. Nick is thrilled when Summer slowly begins to wake up. Nick fills both Victor and Noah in on what happened to Summer. Later, Noah blames Courtney for giving Summer drugs! 

Chelsea gives Adam a list of everything they need to do before they leave town and at the bottom of the list Adam sees, "Get Married”. Meanwhile, Billy tells Kevin that he has a theory.

Abby and Tyler check out a loft that they consider moving into together. As they go to check out the bedrooms, the mysterious dark haired woman listens from outside. When Tyler heads out to work, Abby stays behind to explore the loft. The dark haired woman sneaks inside and locks Abby inside.

videos.title: Episode 10332 - Tuesday, January 21, 2014
videos.overview:
Kyle reveals to Jack that the drug Summer took is being manufactured by Bonaventure Industries. Jack concludes that Victor is to blame for his daughter almost dying. Paul arrives to investigate the complaint filed against Jabot with the labor relations board. 

Dylan and Avery head out of town to look into a new lead on Ian Ward. When they go to a place called The Path, Dylan introduces himself to an employee named Clarence and Avery plays along as his wife. When Clarence asks them who they are and what they really want, Dylan admits that they’re looking for Ian. 

Lauren is upset to hear that Fen has to go back to prison after he broke his house arrest to help Summer. Michael tells Fen that he will find a way to get him out of this nightmare. Michael goes to see Leslie in hopes that she can tell him who turned state’s evidence against Womack.

videos.title: Episode 10333 - Wednesday, January 22, 2014
videos.overview: Gloria welcomes celebrity wedding planner, David Tutera to Genoa City as they wait to meet with Lauren for a meeting.Michael explains to Lauren that Womack said he would leave Fen alone if Michael could tell him who turned state’s evidence against him. Later, Michael and Christine have a heated argument about Fen.Abby and Tyler have a heated argument about Mariah.Passion ignites between Dylan and Avery. Meanwhile, Clarence calls Ian to tell him about Dylan’s search.

videos.title: Episode 10334 - Thursday, January 23, 2014
videos.overview: When Chelsea and Adam tell Billy that they are getting married, Billy questions why they are rushing into it. Later, Billy brings Kevin print outs of all the posts from the grief chat room.Jack and Kyle work to try and establish the trail of the drugs from Bonaventure to Victor. Hilary arrives with a sample of the drug and Kyle finds proof that Victor owned Bonaventure when they started selling the drug that caused Summer to overdose.Chelsea tells Adam that nothing will separate them again.Nikki finds herself face to face with Ian Ward.

videos.title: Episode 10335 - Friday, January 24, 2014
videos.overview: Nikki is shocked to find herself face to face with Ian Ward. Nikki slaps Ian when he suggests that she remembers the past wrong and says that she was a willing participant in the New World Commune. Meanwhile, Dylan and Avery happily return to Genoa City and plan to spend the evening together.Jack and Anita congratulate the happy couple as they exchange their vows. Victor finds out that Adam and Chelsea are married and moving to Paris. Victor tells Adam to either change his plans or he is going to the police.Kyle confirms to Jack that Bonaventure started selling the energy pill after they were under the Newman-Chancellor umbrella. Later, Kyle tells Victor that he is quitting his job at Newman-Chancellor.Adam make a big decision about his future.

videos.title: Episode 10336 - Monday, January 27, 2014
videos.overview:
Chloe is hurt to find out that Chelsea got married without her there. Chloe questions why Adam and Chelsea are rushing to go to Paris. Across town, Kevin tells Paul that he is working on getting information on the person who was posting to Billy in the grief chat room. Kevin is shocked as he and Paul discover it was Adam who hit Delia. Later, Billy takes Adam back to the scene of the crime.

Chelsea comes home and finds Adam’s note and watches his confession on the camcorder.

Jack gives Summer the news that Phyllis is responding to familiar music. Summer asks Jack if he thinks Phyllis will ever come back to them. Meanwhile, Sharon and Nick talks about the visions she’s been having of Cassie.

videos.title: Episode 10337 - Tuesday, January 28, 2014
videos.overview:
Faith interrupts Sharon and Nick saying that she heard a monster or a ghost outside. 

Adam promises to tell Billy everything, but he wants to do it at the police station. Billy refuses and says to tell him what happened or he’s going to put a bullet in him. Meanwhile, Chloe figures out that Adam was the hit and run driver.

Devon asks Hilary if she would like to help with the event at the Athletic Club that will honor Delia. 

Stitch comes by to check on Billy’s hand, but Victoria tell him that he left ours ago and she hasn’t seen or heard from him.

videos.title: Episode 10338 - Wednesday, January 29, 2014
videos.overview:
Dylan and Avery come face to face with Ian Ward. When Ian asks for a chance to tell Dylan his side of the story, Dylan insists that he isn’t interested in anything Ian has to say. Meanwhile, Nikki tells Paul about Ian and wants him to put him back behind bars where he belongs.

When Lauren receives another surprise gift, Michael tells her that he wants to have the prints analyzed but doesn’t think that they should tell the police. 

Victoria and Victor discover that Billy took his gun and that Billy knows that Adam is responsible for Delia’s death. Victoria is frantic to find Billy before he kills Adam. Meanwhile, Adam tells Billy that he can’t bring Delia back and that he knows he is going to jail. 

Summer thanks Sharon for saving her and apologizes for taking the pills. Later, Summer meets someone new.

videos.title: Episode 10339 - Thursday, January 30, 2014
videos.overview:
Paul tells a shocked Jack that he is looking for Adam and that there is a warrant out for his arrest. 

Victoria is frantic to find Billy before he kills Adam. Meanwhile, the battle between Billy and Adam reaches a shocking climax. 

A frantic Chelsea starts to worry that the police won’t believe that Adam kept his confession from her. She is about to leave to bring the camcorder to the police when Chloe is at the door. Chelsea plays the tape of Adam’s confession for her.

Ian comes to see Nikki again telling her that Dylan is living proof that their time together couldn’t have been all bad.

videos.title: Episode 10340 - Friday, January 31, 2014
videos.overview:
Jack confronts Victor about knowing Adam was Delia’s killer and blackmailing him so he could get close to Connor. Nikki questions Victor about knowing Adam killed Delia and why he withheld that information. Across town, Paul broadens the GCPD’s search for Billy and Adam. Nick arrives at the accident site to search for Adam and Billy. 

Christine is preparing Fenmore for his sentencing after he made a deal with her to plead guilty to Carmine’s murder. Michael asks Christine to postpone the hearing, but she doesn’t think the judge will without a justifiable reason.

Christine prepares Fenmore for his sentencing after he makes a deal with her to plead guilty to Carmine’s murder. Michael asks Christine to postpone the hearing until he can get the answers he’s looking for. Michael receives a mysterious phone call and rushes out to pursue a new lead.

videos.title: Episode 10341 - Monday, February 3, 2014
videos.overview:
Jack wonders what will happen to Adam if the police find him. Kevin hopes he’ll be locked up for decades. Chloe asks Victoria if she knows where Billy took Adam and says she hopes Billy kills Adam. Nick shows up and shares what he saw at the SUV crash site. All of Genoa City awaits news on if anyone survived the explosion. 

Anita consoles Chelsea who can’t forgive herself for not figuring out sooner what Adam had done. Chelsea admits that it was a huge mistake trusting Adam again.

Michael receives a mysterious phone call and rushes out to pursue a new lead. Meanwhile, Lauren pleads her case to the judge, taking the blame for bringing Carmine into their lives. Michael returns with shocking new evidence to help Fenmore!

videos.title: Episode 10342 - Tuesday, February 4, 2014
videos.overview:
Chelsea asks Jack to tell her if Adam was the one in the SUV when it exploded. Victor tells Chelsea that she and Connor will always be part of the Newman family.

Billy passes out in Victoria’s arms as she questions him about the crash and Adam’s whereabouts. Later, Paul updates everyone on Adam. 

Lily continues to share her disdain for Hilary’s idea over the theme for Delia’s benefit. Cane thinks they might want to call off the event in light of knowing that the person responsible for Delia’s charity is also responsible for her death. Devon asks for Chloe’s permission to go on with the benefit for Delia’s foundation and offers to give back every dollar Adam donated and double it.

In the park, Noah spots Courtney in the middle of a drug deal!

videos.title: Episode 10343 - Wednesday, February 5, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki tells Nick that Ian Ward is in Genoa City. Nick blames Dylan for bringing Ian to town. Meanwhile, Avery tells Dylan about the tape that Adam made and wishes she could’ve helped him before it was too late. Later, Nick and Dylan call a truce in order to help Nikki. 

Jill surprises everyone at the Chancellor mansion by returning to Genoa City with Colin Atkinson. Lily questions Jill’s story and what really has brought Colin back to Genoa City. Cane suspects his father is up to something and vows to get to the bottom of it. 

Sharon has a shocking encounter with Cassie. Meanwhile, Noah is rattled by Courtney’s confession.

videos.title: Episode 10344 - Thursday, February 6, 2014
videos.overview:
Jill visits Billy and they catch up on everything that’s happened since she’s been away dealing with Colin. When Jill mentions Adam being gone and asks what happened to him, Billy is reluctant to share any details.

Cane questions why Colin is really in Genoa City. Colin tells a disbelieving Cane that he is here for his family and wants to make amends.

Tyler is stunned when Abby tells him that Mariah is joining them for breakfast. Tyler calls Mariah and says that he needs to see her right away.

videos.title: Episode 10345 - Friday, February 7, 2014
videos.overview:
Stitch questions Kelly about sleeping with Billy. When Kelly admits that it was just one night with Billy, Stitch tells her to leave him alone before things get worse. 

Leslie tracks down Neil who asks her how planning their wedding could slip her mind. Neil finally confronts Leslie and asks if she really wants to marry him. 

The police question Billy about the car accident. Meanwhile, Sharon goes to see Chelsea to discuss Adam. When Victor tells Chelsea that Connor and her should come back stay at the ranch, Sharon declares that is the last thing Adam would have wanted.

videos.title: Episode 10346 - Monday, February 10, 2014
videos.overview:
Sharon tells Nick about her run in with Victor. Later, Sharon tries to enjoy a game with Faith but is haunted by Cassie and fears that she’ll never leave her alone. 

Chloe assures Chelsea that Adam being gone is the best thing for her and Connor. A furious Chelsea says that she is going to be on the next flight to Paris, and Chloe panics and says that she can’t let her do that. Meanwhile, after a conversation with Jack, Billy privately keeps the details of his final encounter with Adam to himself. 

Lily tells Kelly about her family’s complicated history with Colin Atkinson. Kelly opens up to Lily and tells her about her son passing away and how her marriage couldn’t survive afterwards. 

When Fen signs his official prison release and learns that the case has been expunged from his record, Christine reminds reminds everyone that they can never reveal that Carmine is alive.

videos.title: Episode 10347 - Tuesday, February 11, 2014
videos.overview:
Billy reminds Stitch that he can’t be kept in the hospital against his will. Stitch tells him to think about the people that love him and not to make things harder than he already has. Billy apologizes to Stitch for giving him a hard time. Meanwhile, Victoria and Nick are shocked when Jack tells them that Victor knew that Adam was the hit and run driver. 

Summer confides in Nikki that she wants to talk to Victor about his feud with Jack. Unbeknownst to Nikki, Summer plans to meet with Ian Ward. Meanwhile, Avery has a tense encounter with Ian and questions what he is really after.

videos.title: Episode 10348 - Wednesday, February 12, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki tries to mediate a heated confrontation between Billy and Victor. 

Sharon opens up to Nick about how she’s been feeling lately. 

When Chloe admits to Kevin that she can’t imagine being at the benefit, Kevin encourages her to attend and reminds her that he’ll be by her side every step of the way. Across town, Chelsea tells Anita that she doesn’t know if she can forgive herself for not seeing that Adam was hiding something. 

Colin tells Cane that he will be on his best behavior at the benefit. Cane vows that better be true, or he will send him back to Australia in a body bag. Later, Colin puts his plan into motion.

videos.title: Episode 10349 - Thursday, February 13, 2014
videos.overview: Cane manages to get Lily to step away from the last minute details of the benefit to go upstairs with him to see the newly remodeled hotel rooms.Stitch tells Dylan that his wife has started divorce proceedings.As the Gala gets underway, Lily tells Kelly that she arranged a blind date for her. When Lily describes the man, Kelly mistakenly thinks its Jack. Hilary watches Jack and takes action. Meanwhile, Tyler takes a phone call from Mariah and agrees to meet with her.

videos.title: Episode 10350 - Friday, February 14, 2014
videos.overview:
Chloe is surprised to see Chelsea at the benefit but asks her to stay. Nick and Sharon arrive with Faith, who is excited to see that Summer has arrived as well. Victoria welcomes everyone to the benefit as Charlie, Mattie and Faith put on their show for the delighted audience. 

Colin tells Cane that he doesn’t think it will be long before everyone realizes he has turned over a new leaf. Meanwhile, Lauren confronts Jill about her relationship with Colin and questions why she is back together with him. 

Sharon has another encounter with Cassie and asks if she is seeing her because of the secret she is keeping from Nick. Nick finds Sharon and offers to bring her back home after he sees that she’s clearly shaken up.

videos.title: Episode 10351 - Monday, February 17, 2014
videos.overview:
Colin encourages Womack to take the diamonds and leave. Womack tells Abby to collect everyone’s cell phones and for Lily to pick up the diamonds. Meanwhile, Paul and Detective Mark Harding arrive at the GCAC and a cop informs them that the doors to the ballroom are locked and the security cameras have been turned off. 

In a moment fueled by anger, Billy tries to grab Womack’s gun, but ends up getting kneed in his already broken rib. Victoria and Kelly struggle to help a delusional Billy who weaves in and out of consciousness. 

Nick encourages Sharon to move up her next therapy appointment and vows to help her. Nick insists on staying at Sharon’s for the night. Victor has a shocking encounter!

videos.title: Episode 10352 - Tuesday, February 18, 2014
videos.overview:
Kelly admits to a horrified Victoria that she and Billy slept together. Meanwhile, Kevin shows Lauren that he was able to keep his GCPD phone and that the police are able to listen to everything that’s happening in the ballroom. 

Womack reluctantly lets a few hostages at a time go as he waits for the plane that Paul promised him. Cane and Lily are the last two hostages and Womack releases Cane but insists on keeping Lily with him. 

Avery and Dylan enjoy a romantic evening together. Meanwhile, Ian finds Summer at Crimson Lights with Faith and realizes they are Nikki’s grandchildren.

videos.title: Episode 10353 - Wednesday, February 19, 2014
videos.overview:
Womack tells Lily that she is his insurance policy. Neil and Devon wants to go up there, but Leslie and Paul remind them that doing so could make things worse. Later, shots are fired!

Nick insists on staying at Sharon’s for the night. Later, the evening takes a surprising turn!

Chelsea tells Kevin that Chloe has taken Connor. Chelsea wonders if finding out about Adam pushed Chloe over the edge or if she had been planning on taking Connor all along. Chelsea calls Victor and asks if he helped Chloe.

videos.title: Episode 10354 - Thursday, February 20, 2014
videos.overview:
At the hospital, Billy struggles to remember the hostage crisis as Victoria sits by his bedside. Billy questions why she is acting so strange towards him and doesn’t realize that she knows about the night he slept with Kelly. Meanwhile, Lily and Kelly have a discussion about her relationship with Billy.

Michael shows Lauren a postcard they’ve received and they realize it’s from Carmine. Lauren worries that since Womack is dead; there is nothing that will stop Carmine from returning to Genoa City.

Following the tumultuous night at the Gala, Cane is cleared to go home from the hospital. When Colin tells Cane that he is glad he could help him, Cane turns the tables and says that Colin has always enjoyed when someone was in his debt. Colin assures Cane that he has no intention of collecting on any type of debt.

Colin asks Jill about the romantic dinner she promised him and suggests making reservations. Jill agrees to a kiss from Colin for information on the music box.

videos.title: Episode 10355 - Friday, February 21, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki asks to check out the life coach that Summer plans on meeting with, but Summer reminds her grandmother that she is an adult and intends to keep her eyes and ears open. Later, Paul realizes that Nikki hasn’t told Victor that Ian is in town. Meanwhile, Summer meets with Ian and he asks her to start by telling her everything about herself. He offers to do a personality test for Summer and says she must put herself completely in his hands. Across town, Dylan tells Nick they should find Ian and convince him to leave town.

Nick comforts Sharon who is still nervous about continually seeing Cassie. Sharon admits that she worries about never being able to get better. Dr. Mead offers to have a session in Sharon’s home since she frequently sees Cassie there. 

Chloe brings Connor to a townhome in Paris. Later, Chelsea and Victor arrive and confront her.

videos.title: Episode 10356 - Monday, February 24, 2014
videos.overview:
Chloe blames Chelsea for letting Adam be a father to Connor. Kevin arrives as Victor tells her that she kidnapped a baby and there is nothing she can do but hand him over. 

Noah returns a present to Courtney that came to his house from her. She tells Noah that everything they had together was real and none of that was a lie just because he now knows that she is a cop. Noah responds by kissing her. 

Summer meets with Ian and he asks her to start by telling her everything about herself. Across town, Dylan tells Nick they should find Ian and convince him to leave town.

Victoria tells Billy that he has broken her heart. Billy begs Victoria to find a way to forgive him.

videos.title: Episode 10357 - Tuesday, February 25, 2014
videos.overview:
Hilary tells Jack they need to talk about the night she kissed him. Jack assures her that what she did was innocent compared to everything else that happened at the fundraiser. Later, Hilary goes to the ballroom to get her phone back and runs into Devon. They share a laugh when Esmerelda interrupts. 

The moment of truth arrives for Neil and Leslie as they discuss their opposing views on marriage. Leslie doesn’t agree that marriage is necessary, but Neil wants her to take a chance with him. 

Billy pleads his case to Victoria saying that he has lost Delia and can’t lose her too. Victoria snaps at him and says not to put that on her. They are interrupted by Jack and Victoria leaves to run some errands. Jack lays into Billy and is surprised when he defends Kelly, prompting Jack to ask if he’s in love with her. Meanwhile, Kelly tells Stitch that she is in no mood for a lecture on how she ruined another marriage. Victoria enters and is surprised to find Stitch with Kelly.

videos.title: Episode 10358 - Wednesday, February 26, 2014
videos.overview:
Avery fills in Dylan and Nick on her strange encounter with Nikki. Dylan mentions John Darwin and Faith pipes in saying that he is Summer’s new friend. Avery shows Faith a picture of Ian and she confirms that he is Summer’s friend. 

When Leslie is unable to change her views, Neil is forced to make a big decision about their future. 

Sharon confides in Noah that she is seeing Cassie again. Noah has a hard time believing that Sharon is considering the idea of a ghost haunting her. 

Nikki puts the pieces together and realizes that Ian is Summer’s life coach. When Nikki calls Ian and tells him to stay away from Summer, he demands $5 million to go away and leave her family alone.

videos.title: Episode 10359 - Thursday, February 27, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki confronts Ian in his hotel room and is shocked to find Summer with him. When Summer questions what has Nikki so upset, Nikki tells her that Ian isn’t who he claims to be. Tensions rise as Nick and Dylan arrive to confront Ian and Paul arrives shortly.

Chelsea tells Jack that Chloe kidnapped Connor and took him to Paris. Jack warns Chelsea that Victor is going to use this against her.

Kevin tells Chloe that she needs to start dealing with her grief. Kevin reminds Chloe that Chelsea understands what she’s been going through which is why she isn’t pressing charges. Later, the evening takes a shocking turn!

videos.title: Episode 10360 - Friday, February 28, 2014
videos.overview:
Victor explains to Chelsea that all he wants to do is help her and Connor. Later, Chelsea receives a call from a blocked number and the person on the other end of the line doesn’t say anything. Chelsea privately wonders to herself if Adam might be trying to reach her. 

Kevin urges Chloe to let Michael build a defense for her, but she tells Michael that she isn’t his client and he can consider himself fired. Chloe shocks Michael and Kevin when she says that what she did was wrong and that she deserves to be punished. 

Colin informs Jill that if she thinks she can solve the riddle on her own and cut him out, then she better think again. Jill doesn’t think there is anything to cut Colin out of considering she thinks he is sending her on a wild goose chase. 

Kelly confronts Stitch about his soon to be ex-wife, Jenna. Stitch tells Kelly he needs to take responsibility for all the times he lied to Jenna. Later, Stitch runs into Victoria at the GCAC gym. She reveals that there is nothing normal for her and Billy anymore and she questions if her marriage is even worth fighting for. Later, Victoria makes a shocking decision!

videos.title: Episode 10361 - Monday, March 3, 2014
videos.overview:
Dylan fills Nick in on Ian’s arrest. Dylan thinks that Ian knows more than he’s willing to let on. Later, Nick finds the Ouija board at Sharon’s and asks if she is trying to contact Cassie. Across town, Courtney prepares a birthday surprise for Noah. 

Neil tells Hilary that he and Leslie broke things off. Later, Hilary questions if Neil is trying to set her up with Devon. 

Billy gently lets Kelly know that in order to save his marriage, they can’t be friends anymore. Victoria returns home to Billy and blurts out that she kissed another man. Their argument turns passionate.

videos.title: Episode 10362 - Tuesday, March 4, 2014
videos.overview:
Leslie tells Ian to not say a word now that she is his attorney. Ian is notified that he will be transferred to county jail. Later, Summer overhears Nick tell Jack about what happened with Ian. Jack and Nick encourage Summer to talk to Nikki about what she is feeling. 

Lily and Cane reluctantly agree to have dinner with Colin. Cane is determined to know what his father is really doing in Genoa City. Across town, Jill admits to Esther that she and Colin are in a race to figure out who the woman in the photo is and why she was important to Katherine.

videos.title: Episode 10363 - Wednesday, March 5, 2014
videos.overview:
Avery explains to Dylan that this mess with Ian ultimately helped Nikki because she finally got to confront him about the past.

Jill and Colin take a surprising journey as they search for answers about the music box. 

Chelsea asks Billy to tell her everything about the last time he saw Adam. Meanwhile, Kevin is determined to do anything he can to save Chloe from being convicted.

videos.title: Episode 10364 - Thursday, March 6, 2014
videos.overview:
Billy tells Jack that he hopes that his marriage isn’t damaged beyond repair. Meanwhile, Abby runs into Stitch and tries to play matchmaker for him and Ashley. 

Victor makes it clear to Cane that Summer was hospitalized because of a drug that Bonaventure is selling and that no one hurts his family and gets away with it. Victor proposes to Cane that if he can clean up the Bonaventure mess, he will make him CEO of the Chancellor part of Newman-Chancellor. Meanwhile, Lily decides to offer up the GCAC as a venue for Chelsea’s upcoming fashion show.

videos.title: Episode 10365 - Friday, March 7, 2014
videos.overview:
Nick tells Noah about how Victor kept Adam’s secret about the hit and run and how that ultimately set things in motion that led to his demise. Sharon sees them talking and Nick invites her to stay for lunch. Noah leaves as Nick and Sharon enjoy the time alone. Later they head home and the sexual tension is almost too much for them to handle. 

Billy and Victoria argue over her kissing Stitch. Victoria declares that she isn’t sorry she did it. 

Chelsea gets angry that Victor doesn’t think Adam could be alive and accuses him of even hoping that Adam is dead.

videos.title: Episode 10366 - Monday, March 10, 2014
videos.overview:
Nick takes Sharon upstairs and they make love. Meanwhile, the Cassie imposter goes to see Victor and tells him he’ll have to find someone new to spy on Sharon. 

Abby tells Jack that she is glad that Victoria and Billy are going to work things out despite Kelly’s involvement. Later, Jack calls Kelly and asks her to meet him for lunch. Meanwhile, Lily finds out that Kelly has left her job at the foundation because of Billy.

videos.title: Episode 10367 - Tuesday, March 11, 2014
videos.overview:
Dylan tries to break up a heated confrontation between Stitch and Billy. Stitch tells Billy to fix his marriage. Meanwhile, Avery is stunned when Victoria asks her to be her divorce attorney. 

Leslie and Neil bump into each other for the first time since their break-up. They stand their ground on their opposing viewpoints regarding marriage. While Neil doesn’t think they can be friends, Leslie insists that she doesn’t want to lose Neil from her life.

Kevin gets angry that Chloe will be pleading guilty and that Michael will support her decision. Kevin wants Chloe to let him fight for her since she won’t fight for herself. Later, Kevin gets an idea to help save Chloe.

Kelly thanks Jack for inviting her to lunch. Jack knows that Billy and Victoria can get through this, and he knows Kelly’s road is tough but she can move forward. After lunch, Jack throws a curveball at Kelly!

videos.title: Episode 10368 - Wednesday, March 12, 2014
videos.overview:
Avery surprises Dylan at the coffeehouse and tells him she has decided to enter an online contest for cooking. Nick arrives and the dynamic between the three of them is surprisingly civil. 

Michael warns Kevin that Chloe doesn’t feel the same way about him that he does about her. Chloe comes to an important decision about her future.

Nikki brings Paul lunch at the police station and thanks him for all his help. Christine arrives also having brought Paul lunch. Sensing the awkwardness, Nikki leaves as Paul tries to reassure Christine that Nikki’s gesture was nothing more than a thank you. Meanwhile, Victor isn’t thrilled when the Cassie imposter shows up at his office. Meanwhile, Sharon prepares herself for whatever treatment Dr. Mead can offer.

videos.title: Episode 10369 - Thursday, March 13, 2014
videos.overview:
At Cassie’s grave, Sharon tells the Cassie imposter that she knows she is here because of the secret she is keeping from Nick. Meanwhile, Victor calls the clinic in Georgia to check on Phyllis. 

Colin overhears Cane tell Lily that he is following up on Victor’s belief that someone set him up with the Bonaventure drug scandal. When Lily tells Cane that she doesn’t want him getting involved with Victor, Cane insists that he doesn’t want his old job back. Colin approaches asks Cane why he is lying to his wife.

Chelsea meets with Jack about the fashion show at the Athletic Club and grows uncomfortable when he starts to question her about Victor. Hilary arrives and Jack informs her that he wants her to be the liaison along with Neil to Forrester Creations.

videos.title: Episode 10370 - Friday, March 14, 2014
videos.overview:
Chloe and Kevin arrive at the Athletic Club and are greeted with an impromptu celebration from their families. Chelsea and Connor arrive as Michael finishes giving his toast to Chloe and Kevin. 

When Stitch warns Kelly to stay away from Billy, Kelly suggests that maybe Stitch is the one that needs to stay out of Billy and Victoria’s marriage. Billy reveals to Kelly that Stitch and Victoria kissed. Later, Kelly tells Billy that Jack tried to pay her to leave town. 

Victor tracks down the homeless man that the police questioned after Adam and Billy’s car accident. The man tells a shocked Victor that he saw a man crawl out of the car before the explosion.

videos.title: Episode 10371 - Monday, March 17, 2014
videos.overview:
Chelsea and Connor arrive at the GCAC as Michael finishes giving his toast to Chloe and Kevin. When Lauren explains that Chloe and Kevin are married, Chelsea questions if they got married just so Chloe could stay out of jail. Later, Chelsea’s announcement shocks Chloe!

Jill tries to find information on Walter Shepherd and Rachel Berenson. Sparks fly between Jill and Colin as they bicker over their treasure hunt. Later, Jill admits to Lauren that blackmail was the reason that she married Colin. 

Abby and Tyler find a story about them being engaged on the GC Buzz gossip blog. Leslie interrupts and says that she knew it was just a matter of time before they got married. Tyler and Abby insist that they aren’t getting married anytime soon. Meanwhile, Tyler’s ex reads the article online.

Victoria tells Billy that she is taking Johnny to spend some time with Reed.

videos.title: Episode 10372 - Tuesday, March 18, 2014
videos.overview:
Nikki tells Victor that Sharon had some sort of breakdown and that Nick stayed with her all night at the hospital. Later, the Cassie imposter tells Victor that she couldn’t get the secret out of Sharon. Victor tells the imposter that she should leave town. 

Dr. Mead tells Sharon they can make the visions of Cassie stop if she wants to and Sharon considers electro convulsive therapy. Later, the Cassie imposter sneaks into the hospital and she goes into Sharon’s room.

Lily knows that Cane has been thinking about Victor’s job offer and asks him to be honest with her. 

Stitch confronts Kelly and asks her to keep his secret. Kelly warns him that the truth has a way of coming out. Later, Lily offers Kelly a job helping her prepare for the fashion show.

videos.title: Episode 10373 - Wednesday, March 19, 2014
videos.overview:
Billy confronts Jack about trying to pay off Kelly. Jack admits that he went too far. Later, Jack finds Kelly in Lily’s office and they have a heated discussion.

Chelsea fears that Jabot is going to drop her line because of all the bad publicity surrounding Adam.

Colin tries to get Jill to admit they love each other despite the lack of trust between them. He tells her never to be scared of loving him. The doorbell rings and Jill finds that the boxes she ordered from the national arches have arrived.

Dylan and Avery question Ian Ward’s ex-wife, Willa.

videos.title: Episode 10374 - Monday, March 24, 2014
videos.overview:
Chelsea tells Victor about the blocked phone call she received and that Billy wants her to stop looking for Adam. Victor calls his P.I. to look into Chelsea’s phone records and also asks for Billy to be investigated until they find out exactly what happened to Adam. Meanwhile, Detective Harding and Paul meet with the homeless man who was at the accident site. 

Leslie and Neil bump into each other as he prepares to head out of town. When Leslie suspects that he is already seeing someone else, she hurries off before Neil has a chance to clarify that he’s only going out of town on business with Hilary.

videos.title: Episode 10375 - Tuesday, March 25, 2014
videos.overview:
Noah and Nick eagerly wait at the hospital for more information about Sharon’s operation. When Sharon wakes up, Nick fears the worst about what she may remember. Across town, the Cassie imposter calls to check in on Sharon. Meanwhile, Jack demands that Victor tell him why he has been checking up on Phyllis.
